description: A sturdy framework of rope-bound planks supports the layers of boar hide and hard-packed earth insulating the interior of the expansive pavilion, the straw-covered ground draped in rectangles of canvas and rolled mats.  A circular fireplace rises at the center of the stone-encircled pit, its candle-covered mantel decorated with rows of carved steins. 36264.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Elongated iron-caged braziers flank the periphery of the stone-edged waters, the drakar-piped wooden tub set below the glass-framed dome showcasing the auroral swirls in the eternal evening sky.  Scattered warg furs cover the planked floor leading towards the log-framed bed, the downy-stuffed mattress piled with thick woolen blankets. title: [Hearth's Desire, Serenity]
36265.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dominating a circular expanse of raised stone surrounded by a small plaza, a sculpted slick stone portal worked into the shape of twining bodies casts sickening radiance upon the surroundings. title: [Den of Rot, Portal]
28817.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The northwestern curve of the plaza ends in an irregular crack where several feet of stone have been shorn violently away from the plateau. 28819.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Just paces away to the west, a wall of igneous rock breaches out of the swampy depths below and continues for another hundred feet before tapering toward a jagged point, like a talon pointing toward the cavern's distant ceiling. 28821.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cracks spiderweb through the floor of the plaza as if an immense object impacted the stone. paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
28822.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A vine-covered wood suspension bridge spans the void between the plateau and another one nearby in the inky expanse of the cavern. title: [Den of Rot, Chasm]
28823.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twin stakes are driven into the hard, dark stone of the plateau, which rises many spans over the boggy floor of the cavern. title: [Den of Rot, Chasm]
28824.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The southeastern curve of the plaza looks out onto the eastern rock face of a torchlit stone grotto far below. title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
28825.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cut and smoothed from the waxy black stone comprising the spindly plateau on which it stands, the plaza slopes a bit toward its eastern extremity. title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
28826.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge stalactite hangs over the northeastern portion of the plaza, its base heavily eroded by seeping, milky water that steams along its mossy length, dripping to form a cloudy pool on the stones underfoot.  Mushrooms, black and banded with vivid orange stripes, have sprung up in the runnel worn by the constantly dripping fluid.
title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
28827.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The plateau occupied by the small plaza comes to a jagged end toward the north and looks out into pitch darkness.  Though oppressive, the sodden blackness is not complete. title: [Den of Rot, Portal Ring]
28828.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stalactites hang low over the rough terrain of the subterranean plateau, their sharp, curved tips almost close enough to touch. title: [Den of Rot, Plateau]
28829.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Towering above the high point of the rocky plateau, an immense jade effigy stands atop a plinth of slick black stone heavily overgrown with fleshy fungi.  The smoothed stone before the great plinth is spattered with effluiva and littered with countless burning candles.  Dancing light from the candles makes it seem as if the statue's carved shift is stirring in the air currents of the cavern.  Stone steps proceed to the east and west, with steeper ones meandering down toward the low point of the ragged plateau.
title: [Den of Rot, Effigy]
28830.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spongy, stinking earth, likely heaped ashore by occasional floods from the nearby subterranean river, leaves only occasional humps of solid stone to breach up from the marshy terrain.  Just to the north, a sliver of higher ground is joined to a tall, spindly plateau.  Meandering stone steps climb the wall of the formation, marching up to an indistinct but vividly feminine figure worked from green stone.  It stands with outstretched arms.
title: [Den of Rot, Stone Steps]
28831.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Carved into a rise in the stone of the subterranean plateau, crude steps ascend toward a great figure of green stone at the rock formation's peak.  Luminous fungi clinging to the cavern's far-off ceiling halo the figure in pale blue and green light, ominously silhouetting tentacles swarming around the great effigy.
title: [Den of Rot, Plateau]
28832.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long stone barrier stretches along the mucky bank of the wide underground river to the north.  Judging from the boggy, sucking ground, the low wall is not enough to prevent occasional flooding from the watercourse, but it keeps the lower terrain from being entirely underwater.
title: [Den of Rot, Flood Barrier]
28833.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hump of rounded black stone breaches out of the swampy muck, bending into a pitch black path to the northwest. Torchlight glows in the southern distance, the source not visible but obvious from its reflection off of a moisture-sheened spot expanse of the cavern ceiling.
title: [Den of Rot, Rise]
28834.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone rise is cragged and treacherous as it crests toward a slick gravel trail bending toward a crooked peninsula of stone that protrudes out into the tenebrous river.  Unleavened darkness presses in, hot and damp, transforming crevices in the stone into pits of unknowable depth.
title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
28835.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Climbing raggedly toward the north, the stone walk cuts across the river.  Steaming water slaps at the land to either side, splashing and fizzing on the stones nearby, but unseen.  The sick sweetness of decay is like an oil slick on the heavy, wet air.
title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
28836.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Corroded steel weapons racks border a training area with a small, mucky pit in the center.  In lieu of training dummies, disease-blotched corpses have been strapped to several posts nearby, their skin scored with slashes from blades and whips.  Sickly green and wan red pennants festoon the top of each post, stirring occasionally in the cavern's air currents as if mocking the deceased.
title: [Den of Rot, Training Yard]
28837.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Etched crudely into the ground is a vast circle with runed edges, the attempts of its creator to follow the bend of the rocky ground resulting in a shape that is slightly oblong and malformed. The edges are blackened and burnt, the surrounding stone smooth save where it is pocked with popped air bubbles.  There is a small break in the circle.
title: [Den of Rot, Summoning Circle]
28838.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small, sloping huts with roofing of mossy thatch dot either side of the stone roadway. Incongruously, the doorless entrances of the huts reveal silken bedding strewn across the plank floors within, the colors riotous but the make uniformly fine.
title: [Den of Rot, Village]
28839.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Suspended between two doorless huts is a bloated disease-ridden body hanging from a quartet of ropes, one tied about each limb.  They are drawn so tight as to provide neither the body nor the ropes any slack.  To the northeast, the path bends toward a cavern wall, but flickering light along the moist stone betrays the existence of a tunnel in that direction.
title: [Den of Rot, Village]
28840.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dense stone walls curve to cut off the path leading from the decaying nearby village, but the path is undeterred. title: [Den of Rot, Tunnel Entrance]
28841.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A winding, well-trodden tunnel proceeds through solid rock, score marks to either side of the path suggesting that it is not a natural formation. title: [Den of Rot, Tunnelway]
28842.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnelway winds like a serpent through the rock, lit only by the occasional torch anchored in gashes and bends in the walls. A torn shred of pale silk is caught on an outcropping nearby, fluttering in air coming through an opening to the east.
title: [Den of Rot, Tunnelway]
28843.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Torches light a noisome, boggy grotto.  Thick vines choke the walls, fleshy and fibrous, unhealthily pale from a lack of nourishing sunlight. title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
28844.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sprouting off of a torchlit overgrown grotto, the docks stretch out over the inky flow of black water.  The wood is decaying and heavily choked with lichen.  Protesting creaks, cracks, and groans rise from the overstrained timbers, rising above the rush of the river.
title: [Den of Rot, Docks]
28845.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tumorous growths defile the vines hanging overhead and cascading down the walls, adding to the blighted, sickly appearance they have developed from growing down in the dark.  The wood plank path bends eastward with the curve of a sheer rock wall that serves as the grotto's boundary.  Sculpted bodies, humanoid and at turns nubile and virile, are carved into the rock in a veritable bacchanal of intertwining forms.
title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
28846.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Proceeding beneath a wall carved with images of unspeakable debauchery, the plank walk begins a steady bend toward the northeast.  To either side of the path are statues of pitted igneous rock that depict hideously contorted humanoids, their limbs twisted into tentacles and their teeth shark-like and sharp.  Were it not for their deformities, their forms would be avatars of perfection, each with immaculate musculature and elegant features.
title: [Den of Rot, Grotto]
28847.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A bend in the stone walls fosters a small cache of crates.  Straw litters the ground and pokes from between their slats in a few places, but the crates seem intact. 28848.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

Sailless, the barge looks sleek and is painted a sharp green, though curls of flaking paint at the waterline suggest that the river has taken a toll on the vessel.
title: [Den of Rot, Docks]
28849.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flat and sleek, the barge has no room for crew quarters and a small depression in the deck that suffices as its hold. Faint, sickly green light seeps from between the slats of the barrel.  Sagging and warped, a gangplank leads down to the bordering dock.
title: [Den of Rot, Barge]
28850.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The plank walkway gives way to solid stone several paces before a pair of inlaid bronze doors. 28851.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A low, illuminated ceiling, bright with gilt and crowded with painted images of grotesque revelry, hangs over the entrance of the temple. 28852.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Suspended from the illuminated ceiling, a chandelier takes the form of interlocking bodies, its bronze construction salaciously emulating supple, preternaturally beautiful forms. 28853.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Beyond the arch separating narthex from nave, the ceilings slope upward. title: [Temple of Rot, Nave]
28854.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A heavy bronze door in the eastern wall is inlaid with wisps of smoke in yellowed jade.  In a niche next to the door, a single censer trails lazy curls of oily black smoke into the air. title: [Temple of Rot, Narthex]
28855.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The nave has a traditional layout, with its central walk proceeding toward a raised dais at the far end, but in lieu of seating, piles of silk cushions and soft, colorful cloth are everywhere. title: [Temple of Rot, Nave]
28856.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28857.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Steps gently rise from the nave toward the chancel, curving outward to avoid an outrageously provocative statue of bronze.  Along the outer steps, pale jade urns hold a bounty of lilac, sirenflower, and lavender.  The blossoms exude a thick, milky sap and the stems are too green.

28858.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Leading up to a raised copper dais, the polished floor has a sickly greenish hue. 28859.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28860.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

28861.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Den of Rot, Lightless Path]
28862.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hundreds of bodies are heaped into the pit, all of them female.  In life, each would have been possessed of surpassing beauty.  They lay heaped atop one another like broken dolls, eyes clouded over.  Together, theirs is an unbearable stench of old blood, death, and seething rot.

28863.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

A few small pines struggle for existence in the frigid conditions.

Glass plates in the ceiling allow sunlight to pour through, and creeping vines, ivies and philodendrons cover the white tile floor, the walls, and anything that fails to move regularly.

Nearby, an oversized cart piled high with goat dung rests in the shadow of one of the tremendous dwellings, filling the air with an earthy and not entirely unpleasant aroma.
title: [Ojandhaart, Runed Arch]
29902.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smoke belches from the rounded chimney of a nearby smithy.  The stones comprising it are huge blackened blocks of ponderous weight.  Crossed axes and a round, notched shield hang over the high open doorway.  The quality of the work is exceptional, but the weapons and targe are too large to be wielded.
title: [Ojandhaart, Smithy]
29903.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The smithy's lofty ceiling is comprised of rough, smoke-darkened tinders.  The cavernous space holds a man-sized anvil and a forge fed by a low-burning flame that nonetheless fills the smithy with skin-searing heat.  Hafts for gigantic axes and a whalebone pommel meant for an immense sword sit atop a huge worktable of sturdy hoarbeam.
title: [Ojandhaart, Smithy]
29904.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Imposing longhouses of unfinished timber tower over the roadside, thatched with dry yellow polar grasses.  The homes are far too large for most humanoids, easily thrice the height of a tall giantman.  There seems little reason or order to their spacing, and the crushed stone road that travels between them meanders and bends accordingly.
title: [Ojandhaart, Longhouses]
29905.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Built atop a craggy mount of granite, a huge hoarbeam longhouse looks out over the village.  Ornate carvings adorn the huge timbers that comprise its walls, while its roof is crafted from riverstone shingles and not the thatchwork of the surrounding huts.  Great steps, cut from the stone of the tor, proceed up to the wide arched entrance.  They are flanked to either side by a pair of colossal stone statues depicting warriors, one male and one female, each armed with twin scimitars.
paths: Obvious paths: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
title: [Ojandhaart, Great Hall]
29906.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rafters of raw pine stretch far overhead, lending the capacious hall a steepled roof.  Tall tables cluttered with earthenware plates and huge bone drinking horns crowd the plank floor, and beneath, the leavings of past meals exude a sour stink.  Both walls are adorned with hammered runes forged from bright copper, which glint and dance in the light of a monumental flame blazing from a dais to the east.
title: [Feasting Hall, Grand Chamber]
29907.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The river swirls and eddies past the limb of icy land.  Huts congregating along its length find their reflections in the icy, slow-moving waters, which also twins the wildly dancing aurora above.  An abandoned fishing net is draped over the shore, empty of its catch.
title: [Ojandhaart, Riverwalk]
29908.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Past a long timber hall that smells heavily of honey and spirits, the frozen earth gives way to crude planking stretching out onto the river.  A garland of woven iceblossoms hangs from the open door, but the dark green leaves are beginning to brown.  The mead hall's open windows look out onto the lonesome dock to the southeast.
title: [Ojandhaart, Mead Hall]
29910.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Aglisten with a fresh coat of polish, a wide spruce bar with ko'nag accents runs along the far wall of the mead hall.  Behind it are fat casks full of mead, the heady odor of honey and alcohol rising from them to fill the capacious space.  High tables are arranged about the room in a rough semicircle, encircled by outsized stools comprised of wood and thick leather.
title: [Ojandhaart, Mead Hall]
29911.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Acrid fumes belch forth from the open windows of a huge hut with hides stretched across drying racks in the surrounding yard.  Bear and wolf pelts commingle with hides that are vivid blue and heavily scaled.  A worktable sits next to the tall doorway of the home, and a skinning knife with a blade nearly the length of a falchion's is jammed, blade first, into the wood.
title: [Ojandhaart, Furrier]
29912.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stench of fermenting solution is almost overpowering within the hut despite the wide windows and open door.  Large stone vats of the stuff sit along the far wall, which is decorated with finished hides and a few crudely mounted animal heads.  The wooden planks of the floor are deeply stained.  A half-skinned white bear sits atop a stone table opposite the vats.
title: [Ojandhaart, Furrier]
29913.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A boundless flame roars from the vastness of a chasm running parallel with the eastern wall of the longhouse, the lowest verges of which are lost beyond sight.  Riotous in hue, the flames have blackened the timbers above, and their heat has left the stone brick hearth behind them pocked and dark.  Buckets full of sweet-smelling herbs burn in the fire, belching thick smoke with a cloying, honeyed aroma.
title: [Great Hall, Pyre of Visions]
29914.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A roaring bonfire burns, started from a collection of stacked pine boles.  It fills the air with smoke and the bite of hot resin.  Light from the cavorting flames drives back the gloom of the sunless sky, casting the surrounding longhouses in radiance akin to daylight.  Several huge benches made from felled trees ring the flame, heedless of the overwhelming heat belching from the pyre.
title: [Ojandhaart, Bonfire]
29915.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tall fence surrounds a wide pasture bordered by several longhouses.  Goats the size of draft horses graze far off to the side of the road, their pale grey wool providing ample protection against the chill.  Leaning against the fence is a rough pinewood crook that looks nearly the size of a young tree.  The goats seem to be thriving while unattended, lazily foraging through the snowfall for shreds of hardy polar grass.
title: [Ojandhaart, Pasture]
29916.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The gigantic longhouses thin toward the northern verges of the village, where an ancient stone henge is comprised of vast standing stones in a rough semicircle.  Granite braziers the size of boulders are positioned along the ring, and their leaping flames envelop the boulders in a dance of dark shadows and golden light.  A path of crushed rock marches toward a breach in the henge.
title: [Ojandhaart, Henge]
29917.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Looming stones stand in a rough semicircle, their shadows long and dark in the enduring twilight.  At their center is an altar of ruddy stone primitively carved with scenes of battle and bloodshed.  An ugly, blade-shaped symbol of blackened metal is set into the flat of the altar.  Intense warmth washing off of encircling granite braziers wars with the chill of the unrelenting wind, which buffets the implacable standing stones in shrieking attacks.
title: [Ojandhaart, Henge of Bloodlust]
29918.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Not a single pine needle mars the pristine white of the even stone road.  There is a painstaking precision to the cut of every stone block comprising it.  Light from the rippling aurora plays off of the road in a ripple of chilly hues, making the pathway appear as if it is undulating slowly, almost imperceptibly.
title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
29920.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road climbs gently to match the rise and fall of the land, flanked on either side by stands of starkly yellow tamarack that ceases to grow several paces from the road's edge.  Off to the side of the road, a leather pack sized for a halfling is stuck in a snow bank that has frozen solid.  The pack seems undamaged and undisturbed, but it is firmly lodged where it fell, the leather twined with fingers of rime.
title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
29921.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide pathway of packed river stones branches eastward off of the road.  Despite the scope of the path, which is easily wide enough for several wagons to travel side by side, it looks primitive and unimpressive next to the precise march of the road it crosses.  Needles of spruce and pine carpet the east-bearing way, not providing it the apparent deference they show the stark white stones.
title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
29922.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The white stone road is shattered by a great hump of disturbed ground.  Whatever broke the earth did so with force great enough to send spiderwebbing cracks out through the surrounding hardpack.  The jagged edges of the broken stones glint oddly in the aurora's light where they are not drowning in the fallen needles of fir and spruce and pine.  Remnants of the roadway dot the ground to the northeast.
title: [Hinterwilds, Geistwalk]
29923.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The trail grows thin and inconsistent as ancient pines intrude upon the navigable terrain.  Some of the tallest cast out long, snowy boughs that block all but the faintest glimmers of the sky in its perpetual twilight.  Off to one side of the road is a small rock cairn.  A young fir droops over it, having sprouted out of the earth near the head of the formation.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29924.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A frozen stream cleaves across the pathway, glinting like fine crystal in the undulating radiance from above.  Spilling from a crook between two granite boulders, the solid water looks trapped in time.  The sinuous thread of ice disappears into the woods to the north, which form an impenetrable tangle of white-dusted greenery several paces from the trail's edge.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29925.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cries of owls and the rustle of rodents fill the air of the gelid woodland.  Nests rock in the boughs of several of the surrounding firs, cobbled together from twigs and bits of twine.  Marching beneath the wild dance of the aurora as it ripples across an unforgiving black sky, the little-trodden path verges on a crystalline briar to the southwest.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29926.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fresh powder coats the hardpack at the middle of the pathway between stands of great sky-scraping firs, making for treacherous footing.  The radiance of the aurora reflects clearly off of the slick layer of frost on the ground.  Watery, refracted light makes the surrounding woods come alive with strange colors and languid, dancing shadows.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29927.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An enormous stone dragon slumbers amidst the woods, snow and underbrush encompassing much of its majestic shape.  Clusters of holly and white dryad have grown over the lifelike statue, blanketing it in incarnadine and niveous patches of flora.  Far more vivid, in jewel-bright colors, are the ice-slicked scales of the beast, a sea of blues and greens fading into burnished coppers.  Were it not perfectly still, it might be a living being.
title: [Hinterwilds, Stone Dragon]
29928.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despite the intensity of the cold, life flourishes in small sanctuaries cradled by the boles of great conifers.  Patches of bright-berried holly grow despite rime caking their spiked leaves.  The trees themselves, spruce, pine, tamarack, and fir, are laden with cones and richly green, as if the cruel weather is little bother to them.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29929.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several abounding trees have burst from the cold, leaving deep fissures down their tortured trunks.  Crystalline resin gleams from the wounds, looking like droplets of amber in a gem shop window.  The verdant needles above suggest that the injuries, while impressive, have done little lasting harm.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29930.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Paw prints in the snow cover the ground near the base of a stand of close-growing pine trees to the southern edge of the pathway.  From the pines comes an occasional clacking sound, its source dozens of small bone fetishes woven into the trees' boughs.  There seems little reason or rhyme to the placement of the grisly talismans, some of which are still marred by ragged hunks of dried flesh.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29931.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide rift disturbs the ground.  It is surrounded by a fringe of broken, icy earth that points angrily at the sky. Heavy snowfall has almost filled the chasm, leaving nary a hint as to its depth or scope, but it appears easily traversible.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29932.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glistening crystals of frost cling to the branches of a lone spruce, weighing the branches down with their sheer numbers.  The tree is a splash of blue-green color in a domain of the woods gone brown and skeletal from the unrelenting cold.  The old stalwart seems little disturbed by the decay around it, glinting brightly in its icy garb.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29933.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sprawled in a heap on the ground, empty eye sockets staring up into the unfeeling light of the aurora, is an immense humanoid corpse.  The stiff, icy body is of sufficient size to mostly block the walkway, and the snow around it is tinged a startling red.  Prints, both humanoid and lupine, encircle the corpse, but despite an arm that ends in a jagged stump, the body seems unmolested since death claimed it.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29934.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Skeletal and greying conifers cast a heavy shadow over a weather-worn runestone just off the edge of the trailway.  The old monolith has been forced askew by the shifting of the chill earth, and it stands at a miserable angle, pointing into the dead trees.  A faint odor of death lingers on the bitter air, and the keening of the breeze is like a banshee's wail.
title: [Hinterwilds, Runestone]
29935.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sickly sweet, the odor of rot is a nauseating pall upon the icy breeze wafting from the northwest.  Rough-hewn timber posts support lanterns meant to hold back the perennial twilight, but they are unlit and look as if they have not been tended in some time.  One of the lanterns has fallen free from its hook, and its broken shards glitter unsettlingly in the light of the aurora.
title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29936.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A gigantic chunk of black stone in the middle of the path leads up to a mist-choked settlement with raw timber walls.  Its appears to have been the rune-carved keystone of a cracked black granite arch marking the road that climbs into the village.  Dead trees coated in a grim, murky frost lend the entire area an ill cast that is amplified by the sweetness of death on the bitter wind.

29937.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mist creeps through the streets of the blighted settlement on cautious tendrils, as if reticent to disturb the sepulchral feel of the ruin.  Burnt out longhouses flank the once grand arch marking the entrance of the village, peppering the air with their charred odor.  The facade of one longhouse has collapsed backward, but the entrance to the other is merely blocked by burnt rubble.  A huge gigas corpse dangles precariously through one of the windows flanking its blocked entryway.

29938.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Great brambles grow to either side of the poorly marked path through the thick briar. A few iceblossoms peek from within the tangled growth as if taunting from their spiked sanctuaries.

title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]

description: A few dreary tatters of homespun fabric waft from the talons of the brambles.  Several of the gnarled vines are snapped in places, as if crushed by a great weight.  Droplets of blood cling to the coiling flora, frozen into sanguine jewels that have their own odd, if frightful, beauty.

description: A frozen pile of spoor sits in the middle of the narrow passage through the briars, the stark bits of bone within suggesting that they are the leavings of a predator. title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]

description: A clearing spans the space before a craggy cave that delves into a hillock of stone at the briar's edge. description: Patches of cerulean and sapphire iceblossoms peek out of the briar here and there, lending splashes of color to the commingling of grey and brown and white.  The mischievous little flowers seem to sprout up where the brambles are thickest, keeping themselves safe behind thorny walls that keep both the wind and clumsy intruders at bay. paths: Obvious paths: east, south, southwest, west, northwest
title: [Hinterwilds, Hoarbriar]

description: Lazing beneath a drooping hoarbeam, the upper half of a silver-shot ancient black runestone pierces up through the stony permafrost. title: [Hinterwilds, Boreal Forest]
29947.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rearing out of the snow-capped trees at the end of a shattered road of white stone, a colossal stone statue stands guard over the woodland. 29948.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glimpses of a vast fane of stone glint through the a break in the monochrome of the snow-clad trees, its cyclopean architecture the color of dried blood in the twilight. A dirt path through the woods, hard-packed by the passage of countless travelers and aglisten with frost, winds northwestward on its way to the distant edifice.

29949.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The heads of immense stone monoliths breach through the white-crowned woods, looking like bloody fingers scratching at the shimmering sky. The roadway winds through the center of the henge.
title: [Angargreft, Henge]
29950.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The shattered tip of a fallen monolith lies scattered across the path, each individual chunk roughly the size of a man. A faint coppery smell lingers on the gelid wind.

29951.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sharp on the frigid wind is a coppery stink that eclipses all other odors, from the crisp bite of pine to the dry aroma of frostbitten wood. Beyond, an immense terraced structure of red stone is visible, its tremendous base tapering toward a narrower zenith.
title: [Angargreft, Wood's Edge]
29952.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rising out of the cold earth, a sky-scraping pyramid of red stone overshadows the area, its cavernous entrance marked by a pair of colossal red stone pillars.  Traceries of rime glisten from its cyclopean walls, reflecting the dancing aurora in shimmering blues and wild greens, but it is a grim and beautiless place, a ruined echo of a monument built to evoke fear rather than wonder.  As if cowed by the display, the trees give the edifice a wide berth, leaving it in solitude amidst a grove cratered with steaming pools.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29953.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The entrance stands, framed by a pair of colossal red stone pillars, at the apogee of a crescent-shaped walk that curves along the interior of the fane. Ruddy stone steps breach the wall to the north, heading precipitously downward into stygian shadow.
title: [Angargreft, Greatchamber]
29954.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Huge, ruddy stone steps descend into unleavened darkness, framed on either side by high walls of the same rust-colored rock. title: [Angargreft, Descent]
29955.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A coagulating incarnadine pool mars the cold, hard-packed earth nearby, steaming in the frigid air, and it is not alone.  The earth to the west is pocked with craters similarly full of thick crimson fluid.  Their scent, like hot copper, is so thick in the air as to be choking.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29956.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: High overhead and toward the western extreme of the great fane is a spacious terrace.  The heavy snowfall cannot obscure the destruction that has consumed the terrace.  Jags of masonry are torn from the red stone walls above, and the space is cluttered with the wreckage.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]

description: Several jagged stones, each as large as a small building, have fallen from the terrace above, heavily scoring the western wall of the fane. The rock is corroded and pitted as if eaten by a caustic substance.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29958.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In the shadow of the fane, clusters of glistening ice crystals crowd around the edges of a thick crimson pond.  The basin is fed by a lethargic spill of crimson fluid trickling down the bordering wall, but its source is lost amidst the shattered ruin of the western terrace above.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29959.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Near the edge of the woods, a stone formation stands, towering over the neighboring trees.  Pine and spruce near the clearing are denuded of their needles.  The light of the aurora above filters through their branches, casting bleary shadows on the cracked white ground.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29960.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An alcove to the east of the fane's entrance is cavernously deep.  A tall gigas statue stands wreathed in shadow, proud features ominously glaring down on the indurated earth below.  The ground before the statue is littered with offerings frozen into a clump of ice crystals.
title: [Angargreft, Sanguine Grove]
29961.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As the high-walled corridor curves toward the northwest, the statues give way to painted effigies along the walls. A smear of brighter, newer red bisects the ancient paintings, marring their flow.
title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
29962.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A constant, sluggish flow of thick crimson fluid cascades slowly down the eastern wall. Primitive painted figures on the wall's surface have surrendered to the crimson flow, leaving the remaining lines looking half-formed and obscene.
title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]

description: The slabs of ruddy, iron-laden stone that comprise the floor slowly rise as the corridor bends to the northeast. They are denuded of whatever treasures they once held, but pottery shards and bits of broken bone swept to the corridor's borders hint at vases and ancient art.
title: [Angargreft, Spirit Walk]
29964.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A snarling visage has been carved into the stones of the northern wall with surprising skill, its vast maw a gaping sea of shadow.  The darkness beyond is all the more impenetrable for the flickering glow of two torches hanging in sconces to either side of the portal.  They are burning blue.
title: [Angargreft, Descent]
29965.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A crumbling red stone maw in the southern wall opens onto a vast nexus of cavernous catacombs. description: Wailing and biting, the gale shrieking down off of the icebergs in the distance carries a cruel chill.  In concert with the seaspray, it has coated the pier in ice crystals that gleam and glisten, distracting from the rotting wood beneath.  Some of the planks, clad in icy skin, shine like polished glass.

title: [Frostmain Docks, Cold Pier]
32372.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gravel-clad and jagged, an incline climbs away from the shore toward a highland ridge that overlooks the water.  Gulls and other sea birds have stained the rocks with their leavings, but otherwise the shale is unrelieved and tenebrous.  The desolate expanse of black stone is mostly impassible, but a rocky shoreline trail connects the shore with a low point in the ridgeway.
title: [Crawling Shore, Incline]
32374.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sand and stone meet in a clash of blacks and greys, the volcanic grit darker by several shades than the sharp bits of shale that have tumbled down the incline to the east.  Though whipped by winds wailing off of the Frostmain's frigid waters, the area is graced by patches of scraggly vegetation, mostly tenacious weeds that have found purchase in crags and furrows in the earth.
title: [Crawling Shore, Lowlands]
32375.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fresh snow shines in patches atop the rock and sand that defines the unforgiving lowlands near to the shore, mostly occluding a wispy trail that winds aimlessly westward.  Abandoned in a nearby drift, a carved maple sled sits at the side of the road.  The way does not appear to be well traveled, as tundra grasses have grown over the path in places.
title: [Crawling Shore, Lowlands]
32376.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crisp is the breeze, brined heavily with the salt of the ocean, as it scours the lowlands.  The trailway ascends through a patch of ruddy scrub toward a small slope.  Rudimentary attempts to line the path with gravel seem to have ended in defeat, leaving behind loose, skittering stones that hinder progress more than help it.
title: [Crawling Shore, Lowlands]
32377.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Its base secured by a trio of flat boulders that are covered with the remains of spent tallow candles, a totem of carved driftwood rises out of the ground.  The boulders' faces are carved with leaping dolphins and swirling patterns that are repeated in bright paint on the totem alongside a stern, bearded face and the repeated image of a golden trident.  Beads, bits of seaglass, and other offerings have been heaped at the totem's base.
title: [Crawling Shore, Totem]
32378.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: One of the few hills of substantive size this near to the shoreline has a wide open mouth framed by an arch of cut stone.  The barrow is clad in downy seaside mosses, sparse but vividly blue-green in hue.  Footsteps have worn a grim furrow into the space before the aperture.
title: [Crawling Shore, Barrow]
32379.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gleaming mica and bits of quartz wink from the black sands that consume the path toward the shoreline.  The powdery grit rolls in low, wave-like dunes and is strewn here and there with bits of bone and whole shells.  To the northwest, on a low bluff above the bleakness of the beach, a quiet village shelters beneath an uncaring sky.
title: [Crawling Shore, Ebon Sands]
32380.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A walrus skeleton has been heaped onto the sand as if by an exceptionally high tide.  Though crabs and other scavengers have picked every last scrap of flesh away, they have left the bones remarkably intact.  The splintered remains of a spear shaft lie nearby, its head a shattered piece of obsidian with jagged edges.
title: [Crawling Shore, Ebon Sands]
32381.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despite the bitter cold of the windswept shores, life flourishes in a shallow tidepool near the water's edge.  Framed by jagged blocks of banded shale, the pool is clear, its water occasionally refreshed by the onslaught of the tide at its height.  Beneath the surface, jewel-toned blue crabs shuffle about on beds of algae, accompanied by pale white clams and black mussels.
title: [Crawling Shore, Tidepool]
32382.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Seawater swirls slowly on the ground, carrying bits of muck toward a deep sucking sinkhole near the water's edge.  Up above, on a bluff with steeply cragged sides, rest signs of civilization in the rooftops and palisade walls of a small village.  Despite the buildings' presence, the breeze carries only the cries of gulls and the roar of the crashing waves.
title: [Crawling Shore, Sinkhole]
32383.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Swirling muck and sucking goo covers the bottom of the sinkhole, fed by a constant trickle of frigid seawater and sandy mud from above.  A rope ladder dangles from the sinkhole's aperture, which occupies a good third of its crumbling ceiling.  Nearby, a silver stake lies mostly submerged in the water.
title: [Crawling Shore, Sinkhole]
32384.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cold tide laps at both sides of a bridge of black sand leading out toward a rocky promontory.  Ravenous, the waves look to be on the verge of eroding the tenuous bridge, leaving its stony destination an island.  Bitter brine sprays frequently through the air, icy cold and endless.
title: [Crawling Shore, Ebon Sands]
32385.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Waves rage against the jagged stones of the promontory, sending up explosions of icy saltwater.  Crabs scuttle in the dark places between the stones, bright blue bodies starkly colorful against the monochrome of the black rock.  High tides have trapped kelp and other, more ambulatory sources of sustenance for the little crustaceans.  The finger of stone stretches defiantly out into the water, looking out onto a phalanx of vast icebergs.
title: [Crawling Shore, Promontory]
32386.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A path strewn with fragments of shale climbs toward the simple wooden gate of a village perched atop a bluff overlooking the beach.  The gate is the sole opening in a wooden palisade of sharpened stakes that surrounds the holdfast.  A faint, sickly sweetness lingers on the air despite the howling ocean breeze.
title: [Crawling Shore, Village Path]
32387.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though the surrounding palisade wall does little to mute the cries of gulls or the whistling of the western wind, the holdfast swathed in eerie silence.  Not a child's cry stirs the air, and the surrounding huts, with their pine-and-tar construction and rooftops thatched with tundra grass, have a hollowness to them that betrays a lack of habitation.  Near the gate that is the sole means of egress from the hold, a net full of skeletal fish lies forgotten.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32388.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circle of stones too flat and rounded to be natural sits at the intersection of several dirt roads.  There is a wide firepit at the center, though its flames and the stories that were doubtless told by their side are but ghosts of the past.  Gull droppings now stain the flats of the rocks.
title: [Crawling Shore, Village Circle]
32389.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Standing atop the highest point in the holdfast, the remains of a charred wooden hut stand amid a patch of burnt brush.  Crumbling, blackened logs are heaped at the base of the hut.  There are boards across the door, but whatever was securing them lost its purchase in the blaze.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32390.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A pyroclasm consumed the interior of the hut, gutting it and leaving behind only a barely standing frame of wood.  What remains of the door squeaks in the breeze, swaying on charred hinges.  Five skeletons lie amidst the ruins, blackened beoynd recognition, but next to them is a man-shaped space where the floor is clear of char.  No sign of the space's occupant remains.
title: [Crawling Shore, Burnt Hut]
32391.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Graves mar a patch of land to one side of the street.  A sturdy shovel is driven into the heart of one of the graves, but it has been there long enough for the briny air to devour much of the exposed metal.  Another, strewn with dried flower petals, is open, the dirt filling it thrown aside as if by great force.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32392.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A lone tree stands over the roadway, the sole tree in the holdfast.  The white bark is flaking and has a pleasantly effervescent smell.  Ribbons festoon the trunk, knotted from a variety of materials from coarse wool to fine silk, but they are old and bleached by the sun.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32393.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dolphins painstakingly awakened from dark rock flank the entrance to a blue seastone shrine at the end of the winding road.  Iseya lichen has found purchase between the stones of the walls, the sharp silvers and teals of the flora brighter than the muted blue of the seastone.  A few half-spent tallow candles sit to either side of the entrance, their blackened wicks sodden from the sea air.
title: [Crawling Shore, Shrine]
32394.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moonlight beckons through chinks in the stones of the shrine's rounded ceiling.  Shafts of pale radiance bathe a glistening seaglass statue of a powerfully built half-krolvin with a heavy beard, a trident held aloft in one blunt hand.  Offerings of strange golden coins and carved whalebone charms are heaped before the figure.  The air is redolent with the odor of the spent tallow candles that fill niches along the walls.
title: [Crawling Shore, Storm Shrine]
32395.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Choked with weeds and blanketed with fallen snow, an herb garden stretches from the side of the road to the border of the palisade.  Several gardening tools, including a spade with a handle of carved bone and a bent shovel, lie scattered across the earth.  The garden's perimeter is demarcated by dark chunks of shale harvested from the beaches below.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32396.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge carved richly adorned with scrimshaw hangs from the entryway of a large wooden hut with a pine plank deck.  Earthen beds to either side of the walkway leading toward it hold the dried husks of iceblossoms.  The road curves away from the home as if avoiding the splintered remains of a door that once secured the home.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32397.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The interior of the hut was once a sizeable single room with an earthen hearth and a curtain delineating a bedchamber with a frame and overstuffed mattress full of goat wool stuffing.  The curtain has been slashed, and the copper cookwares are scattered across the ground, twisted into unrecognizable shapes.  The smell of dried iceblossoms, sweetly herbal, lingers amid the destruction.
title: [Crawling Shore, Hut]
32398.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ruined huts, their walls collapsing and their windows smashed, crowd in on the road.  Near one, a sled is loaded with sodden bundles of clothing and other belongings.  The crimson edge of a sweater peeks from one bundle, the spot of color jarring in the greying landscape.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32399.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road begins a gently decline near a corner dominated by the remains of a tanner's hut.  Though the interior is ruined and choked with debris from the collapsing thatch of its roof, the smell of tanning agents and dyes is still acrid on the air.  A walrus skull, its eye sockets empty, stares from one of the intact windows, dispassionately watching the village's decay.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32400.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pathway between houses descends steeply toward a finger of land protruding from the palisade out into the unforgiving waters of the Frostmain.  To one side of the road stands a wooden hut with a thatched roof of long-dried grass that has caved in, undone by the weight of snowfall.  Blankets and clothing are strewn before the steps of the hut, unmoving save when they are tugged by an errant breeze.
title: [Crawling Shore, Holdfast]
32401.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Snow swathes the wood plank floor of the hut, strewn with bits of grass thatching from a ragged hole in the roofing.  A bed that is scarcely more than a wool-stuffed mattress on the ground lies half-buried under the snow, spotted with the unsavory darkness of mold.  Oddly undisturbed, a carved whalebone figurine sits atop the hearth of a fireplace in the eastern wall.
title: [Crawling Shore, Hut]
32402.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the west, at the lowest point of the holdfast, a dock of time-silvered wood stretches out over the waters of the sea, shaking each time the waves pound against its aging timbers.  Woven baskets crowd the nearby shoreline, most empty and several pulverized and rent apart.  Up on the bluff above, huts stare outward with empty, lightless windows.
title: [Crawling Shore, Dockside]
32403.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small fishing vessels are moored to the dock by brittle lengths of rope that creak with the rise and fall of the waves.  Devoured by salt and and compromised by neglect, they have begun to take on water, and several silver fish dart around in the lower third of the nearest.  Some woven baskets cram the uneven planks of the dock near where it meets the shore, emitting a horrific, sour stench.
title: [Crawling Shore, Dock]
32404.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Painted scenes adorn the walls of the barrow near the entrance, which allows gelid moonlight to filter into the stony surroundings.  The paintings are crude at first, depicting strange nautical settings and scenes of battle and death, but the artistry refines as the images proceed further into the cave.  A scattering of bones clogs the pathway.  Some still have flesh on them, and none have yellowed with age.
title: [Barrow, Entrance]
32495.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Dried and dusty corpses litter the ground as if dumped from the hollows that honeycomb the walls.  Most look to have been half-krolvin, their dried skin possessing bluish or grey hues.  One niche holds a recently deceased body, the colors of its flesh not yet muted by death.
title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
32496.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cold is intense as the burrow's tunnel proceeds deeper into the earth, flanked by niches full of corpses new and old.  Air whistles through the tunnels in low moans, knife-sharp, but its chill keeps the odor of death to a low sickly sweetness.  Bootprints disturb the loamy earth, the patterns too distinct to have been there for long.
title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
32497.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hideous symbols in blood mar the honeycombed walls of the barrow, the sinister luminescence throbbing from the sigils less bright but steadier than the flicker of torchflames lighting the path.  Blazing in unnatural reds and violets, the torches proceed toward an arched opening to the southwest.  The fire almost manages to hold back the oppressive cold of the frozen earth.
title: [Barrow, Corpse Walk]
32498.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, circular chamber yawns at the barrow's end, lit by roaring violet and crimson flames roaring from torches in sconces around the room.  Crudely carved from porous black stone is a squat, misshapen figure with membranous bat-like wings.  He stands atop a defaced altar of crimson-stained stone.  Staring down at the scene is a three-faced etching in the wall that has been slashed and raked so badly as to be almost unrecognizable.
title: [Barrow, Altar of the Tenth]
32499.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Braying barks fill the air, rising from a bob of indolent seals who have claimed the black sand beach as their own.  Nearby, but still at a safe distance from the eyes of the judgmental pinnipeds, an open-air workroom has been constructed from pine and pitch on a short dock jutting over the water.  Several damaged boats are moored or dry-docked close to the structure.
title: [The Frostmain, Seal Point]
34067.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A jut of volcanic stones jabs into the frigid grey waters.  Seafoam clings to the black rocks, its susurrus a steady counterpoint to the crashing of the waves.  Though the air is crisp and clean, a faint scent of fishy brine lingers on the icy breeze and is especially thick around a small dark shack built along the shore.
title: [The Frostmain, Black Jetty]
36292.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Black basalt knuckles punch seaward, their slick faces lacquered with brine and rime.  Icy swells heave against the point, breaking to spindrift that salts the air.  A carved totem, weathered until only flakes of paint are left on its surface, rises from a cleft in the rock, its grim faces stacked in storm-dark wood, whalebone tusks pegged into snarling mouths.  Wedged into the spaces between black stones, abandoned rods lean like tired old men, lines trailing in the water.  The air smells heavily of kelp.
title: [The Frostmain, Talbot's Point]
36293.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Though a bit ramshackle and ill-built, the small one-room shop is built to hold out most of the cold.  Rods of various lengths and makes hang from hooks along the walls.  A firepit has been dug into the floor, and in it burns a small fire that warms the room and fills the air with the smell of woodsmoke.  Near to the slightly slanted counter sits a rhimar-lined black wooden chest that smells faintly of cold fish.
title: [Kravzhak's Crab Shack, Shop]
36294.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several armed guards stand outside a hole in the wall, watching all who enter and exit Icemule Trace.  Halflings bundled against the cold wander in and out of the gate, some leading pack animals while others carry large packs on their back.  A trail leads off to the northeast, and although it's slick and icy, the halflings seem to pay no notice to the dangers.
title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
3307.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A sheer cliff of ice blocks the ice trail.  A crevice opens in the wall, likely leading into and perhaps under the glacier.  The sparkle of the sun on the ice is nearly blinding, making your eyes squint and water.
A sheer cliff of ice blocks the ice trail.  A crevice opens in the wall, likely leading into and perhaps under the glacier.  Moonlight sparkles on the ice illuminating the area.
title: [Icemule Trace, Exterior]
3308.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lit only by a single iron-sconced torch east of the gated entrance, this ice-enclosed cavern is filled with an unwelcoming silence and a sense of foreboding.  To the northwest, countless stalagmites of crystalline ice jut wickedly upwards towards a suspended rope bridge far above the penitentiary floor.  Garbed in hooded black robes, a pair of grizzled halflings guard a thick imflass-chain ladder that leads upwards into the Icewall.
title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Entryway]
3309.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The crevice walls press close together, giving you a sense of claustrophobia.  A crack in the wall of ice provides the only exit to the outside, and the ice slopes downward opposite the fissure, leading into the gloom.
title: [In The Crevice]
3310.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cold seeps into your bones, seeming to chill your very soul.  The tunnel through the ice is short, suited for halflings and those of a like size, if only just.  It does not seem to be naturally formed, and long grooves in the walls appear to have been made by ice picks.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Entryway]
3311.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rough edges of the wall give the reflecting light an eerie cast that plays tricks with your eyes.  Glancing at the reflection coming from the bend of the wall, you can see hundreds of shapes moving in agitation.  Quickly, almost hopefully, you realize this is but a trick of the light.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3312.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Jagged plates of ice flow over one another, forming the roof of the tunnel.  The occasional groan of shifting ice makes you start and glance nervously upwards, saying a silent prayer that the tunnel does not collapse upon you.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3313.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tunnel sharply turns back on itself here, disorienting you slightly.  This, coupled with the sloping floor, causes you to slip several times as you make your way through the ice.  Your own breathing echoes about you, making you tense with unease.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3314.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep grooves mar the walls of this corridor.  Further inspection leads you to believe that these are sword slices, likely from someone swinging a blade too long for the size of the tunnel.  A shudder passes through you, although from the cold or something else you cannot tell.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3315.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ice glows a dirty grey, reflecting light from above the ice.  Occasionally a whisper of sound touches your ears, giving you goosebumps.  The tunnel winds to the northeast, where you can see dark shapes within the ice.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3316.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hole in the ice opens in the north wall.  Through it, you can make out the details of the shapes in the ice, seeing them to be the remains of buildings.  Shapes flicker through the ice, making you very uneasy.
title: [Ice Tunnel, Winding Passage]
3317.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ice forms a small natural cavern here.  Within the walls, you can see the flattened remains of several houses, crushed to bits by the flow of the glacier.  The rubble is still in good relative condition, as if frozen in time.  A hole opens in the ice to the south.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3318.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tiny cottage sits perfectly preserved within the glacier.  Several children's toys sit in the yard, and a broom leans against the stoop.  You can almost see smoke rising from the chimney, as if a fire still burned in the hearth.  But the windows remain dim, and the scene has an eerie air of timelessness about it.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3319.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The collapsed husks of several houses lay entombed in the ice.  The occasional board or piece of metal sticks out of the ice, almost as if reaching for freedom.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3320.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: All that remains here is a large pile of boards and glass.  You cannot tell what these buildings might have been, as the damage is far too complete.  As you look away, something catches your eye, and looking again, you see something sticking out of the rubble that looks suspiciously like an arm.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3321.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: You must step carefully in this room.  Unfinished (yet rather sharp) sword blades poke out of the ice at your feet, threatening to shorten you by a foot.  They seem to have come from the remains of a shop smashed by the ice, the pieces of a sign in the shape of a sword indicating that this was once the armory.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3322.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ice takes on a greyish cast, colored by the soot from the forge it has crushed.  Twisted wrecks of metal lay within the frozen walls, and tools have been scattered across the dirt at the front of the building.  An anvil sticks out of the ice, nearly making you stub your toe.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3323.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Several poor-looking shanties have been demolished by the glacier.  Their condition was likely never sterling, and it's likely that the glacier sped the process that time eventually would have completed.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3324.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The unmistakable scent of mule manure reaches your nose.  Sticking partially out of the ice is a stable, and unfortunately, the scent did not freeze with the building.  Pieces of harness and tack hang from the fence, slowly rotting in the moist air, and straw dusts the floor.  You involuntarily wrinkle your nose, trying not to sneeze.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3325.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A neatly-kept house sits enveloped in several feet of ice.  The back half, as well as much of the left side, has collapsed, crushed by the ice.  The rest looks much like it must have before, the paint bright and lovingly done.  A small garden has been plotted in the front yard, carrot stalks flattened against the ground and heads of lettuce splattered across the dirt.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3326.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ice glimmers and scintillates, refracting the light from gems and gold trapped within.  What was a gemcutter's shop has been destroyed by the movement of the glacier, its wares scattered and entombed by the ice.  Chip marks in the ice indicate that someone has attempted to salvage the jewels, but was largely unsuccessful.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3327.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your breath echoes off the walls of this huge chamber.  At the north side stands a large temple.  An immense plate of ice sits atop it, slowly crushing the finely varnished wood.  Colored glass litters the floor, forced from the windows by the pressure the ice is putting on the structure.  You cannot help but marvel that the building still stands, and wonder if perhaps it is only faith that allows it to do so.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3328.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: What once was a two-story house sits at the edge of this cavern.  A huge slab of ice has knocked the second story down, scattering bedding and parts of furniture across the slick floor.  The rest of the house creaks and groans, as if it could fall to bits at any moment.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, southeast, west
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3329.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cart sits flattened within the ice.  Fruits and vegetables sit around it, some pulped, others whole, wrinkled and withered from the cold but still in decent condition.  A mule harness remains attached to the front, twisted by the force of the glacier.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3330.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bright swathes of cloth from beneath the ice-bound rubble mark what was once a tailor's shop.  The ice reflects the colors, creating jumbled rainbows about the tunnel.  Little other than the fabric remains intact, and you only hope that the proprietor of the shop made it out in time.
title: [Icemule, Ruins]
3331.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The guards at the top of an imflass-chain ladder stamp their feet in a vain attempt to fight off the biting cold.  A single torch set in an unadorned iron sconce provides only scarce light, causing shadows to flitter about the area.  Near the torch, a thick imflass door has been fixed securely into the ice and bears a prominent mithril plaque.  To the west, a suspended rope bridge crosses a narrow chasm.
title: [Icewall Penitentiary, Ledge]
15794.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tracks of previous travelers wander aimlessly through the snow.  A large spruce tree lies on the ground off to the side, covered in ice and snow.  The small open area where the tree once stood lets the bitter-cold breeze flow through the area.
The silence of the snow-covered forest is frightening.  Distant howls of coyotes and occasional sounds of snow falling from high branches is all that can be heard.

It is difficult to see any great distance through the dense forest.  Landmarks are sparse, making it tough to navigate your way out of the trees.  You hear a faint rustling coming from a small bush off to the side of the trail.
An oddly shaped cedar tree stands off to the side of the trail.  An owl is startled by your presence, and its screech echos through the forest as it flies off.
The path here winds through the trees and braches off into several directions.  You have lost all sense of direction and wonder if you are ever going to make it out of this maze.
Tracks from a snowshoe hare meander in and out of the dense forest.  A few fallen branches lay in the middle of the trail, but are not large enough to impede your progress.

The trees are starting to all look the same, giving you the feeling you are lost.  The tops of the conifers sway silently in the chilly breeze.  You notice a small critter darting through the woods out of the corner of your eye.
The tracks in the snow here look familiar, making you wonder if you are just walking in circles.  A strange chittering coming from up in a tree echos through the cold dry air of the forest.

Snow drifts against fallen trees off of the beaten paths.  Occasionally, the sounds of snow falling from branches can be heard throughout the forest.  The trees all look alike, making you wonder if you have been here before.

The ceiling is also granite, but mottled and rippled with waves, bubbles, and other inexplicable deformities.  The outline of a large, distorted pentagram has been traced into the polished floor with thick lines of reddish eahnor.  Placed in the center of the pentagram is some bronze lettering.  An irregular alcove proudly displaying a dark fel case engraved with miniature Igaesha has been hacked out of the wall directly across from a riveted steel door.

A well-organized collection of metal tools lies on top of a small oaken table, while a set of bronze implements hangs from the side of the brazier.  A torturer's rack is propped up against one wall.

Out of a hole in its center rises a granite pedestal, and along one wall hangs a colorful tapestry depicting a battle scene.  Comfortably out of reach, some bloodied Faendryl armor has been affixed to the ceiling above the pedestal.  On a stone shelf are a pair of elaborate veil iron shackles and a crumpled battle flag.

A series of glowing red runes in the floor encircles a rough stone altar, and the granite of the ceiling has been carved into an explosion of thick sculptured tentacles.  Hanging from bronze hooks on one of the walls is an assortment of filthy blades, hammers, and tongs.
