description: A beached ship lies in the middle of the field here, no clues or explanation as to how it arrived.  The once shiny maoral wood has dulled now with age, and the ship's ribs and masts have split and fallen.  The only passengers of the vessel are the rats, which number in the thousands.  It's almost as if the boat itself writhes with their movements.  High above, on the one remaining mast, flies a flag bearing a rat skull and crossbones.
title: [The Rift]
2630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A marble wall stretches for some distance to either side of you.  In the center of the wall hangs a golden scale, with a small shelf on either side of it.  On each of the shelves lies a shiny razor and a white towel.  The bowls of the scales are spotless, although they have a slight coppery odor.
title: [The Rift]
2631.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide stretch of forest opens before you, the huge border of trees giving the impression of stoic guards protecting their land and secrets.  Packs of ghostly dogs run toward you at the will of a huge, antlered man commanding them at the forest border.  His bony finger points to you, and the dark gleam in his eye tells you he will not allow passage further into the woods.
title: [The Rift]
2632.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This part of the cavern seems intimate after the expansiveness just around a bend of the red stone.  Recesses all along the east wall give the rock a filigreed appearance which belies the vast size of each enclosure.  The fine sand is a constant carpet, however, the light it expends is much dimmer here, fading to a soft twilight within the eastern niches.  To the south, the walls swirl to create an oval passageway into another cavern where more of the recesses can be glimpsed.
title: [Birthing Sands, Cavern of Ages]
2635.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The chamber's walls are modulated with the same large recesses that pocket the walls of the chamber to the north.  Inside each, the red stone is polished to an indulgent surface that highlights the striations in the rock.  On the cavern's eastern wall however, something went horribly wrong.  The undulating niches are blasted into shambles around a central oval just behind a golden pedestal with a nebulous sphere hovering above it.  There, the rock appears to have melted, running down the cavern wall in eddies of molten stone.
title: [Breach, Cavern of Ages]
2636.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: After the bitter, numbing cold of outside, the luxuriousness of warm air is all encompassing.  Then the surroundings creep upon one's consciousness, like a panoramic view emerging as fog lifts.  Red stone walls arch in ridges overhead, reminiscent of an immense rib cage.  The cavern's higher regions are remote and dark, however, soft light radiates from a fine, ivory-colored carpet of sand that stretches from wall to wall.  Heat rises from the sand as well, lending a shimmering quality to the air.
title: [Heated Sands, Cavern of Ages]
2637.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An amazing pile -- more a mountain really -- of old chests and boxes inhabits this region of the cavern, rising up out of the drifts of fine sand, a monumental refuse heap of riches that have vanished.  The boxes are apparently empty, most of them gaped open and lying upon each other in various stages of decay like fallen soldiers.  Not even the tarnished hardware avoids the appearance of desolation.
title: [Horde, Cavern of Ages]
2638.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The warm water of the lake churns in the grip of strong currents.  Tossed by the confluence, water droplets spray into the air above the waves, creating shimmering rainbows in the low cavern light.  The bank of the lake beckons with its promise of solid ground, while below, the depths descend into shifting shadows.
title: [Lake of Tears]
2639.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Currents roil the tepid water, with bits of debris and sand caught in a hectic dance.  Overhead, light filters down in shifting beams, which flicker at the mercy of the water's movement.  A shadowy opening creates a fissure in the rock walls, and below that, the lake descends into darkness.
title: [Lake of Tears]
2640.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The currents kick up sand into a shifting curtain.  Light from above barely intrudes, splicing into the gloom in weak shafts, which flicker as the currents assault them.  An array of curved spines rises out of the sands on the lake's floor, looking like a huge arching fan in the wavering shadows.
title: [Lake of Tears]
2641.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Turbulence heaves the water into a nightmarish beast, smashing against the rough rock walls of the dark tunnel and then rolling over itself in a roaring fury.  Vague light ventures in at either end of the confining passageway, but quickly fades as if in deference to the currents' delirious momentum.

The roar of water crashing against the rock walls of the tunnel is deafening, its voice a low rumble that penetrates the rock where the water, for all its fury and force, cannot reach.  At each end of the watery maelstrom, low light filters in.  However, the violent cascade filling the passageway obscures what little illumination can be seen.

The currents careen through the hollow rock in a rampage.  It's impossible to tell if they follow a specific course, or merely churn and rage through the tunnel in an unending assault against the confining walls.  Light is barely visible at each end of the subterranean passage, however, a strange phosphorescence outshines it, glowing from the rock walls with an unearthly emerald light.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
title: [Water Tunnel]
2642.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The depths churn with ferocious tenacity, tossing everything within its embrace like leaves caught in a wind.  Directions are difficult to ascertain, and even the brave beams of light filtering down into the morass seem to bend and stretch in response the currents' vicious onslaught.  Through a momentary lull in the flux, the rough surface of the rock wall of the pool is revealed, scarred by pits and depressions.
title: [Pool]
2645.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The water is a startling shade of cerulean blue, edged with deeper blue shadows.  It moves vigorously, tossing itself over and under, and throwing sprays of drops high into the air at the command of hidden currents.  Above the pool, a large finger of stone extends over the pool, casting a shadow on the waves below it.  Standing behind the pool's rim, a throne can be seen, sitting silently as if meditating on the movement of the water.
title: [Pool]
2646.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ledge is more generous than it appeared from the lower stone platform, which now looks extremely narrow and far below.  The view from here of the monumental ice sculpture reveals its top to be as superbly detailed as its other aspects.   Incongruously, a pool of clear, sapphire-colored water lies between the ledge and an immense statue of a sleeping drake, its recumbent body curled around a large throne on the pool's northern edge.
title: [Altar of the Elder]
2647.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mist from the pool lays a fine sheen on the ice covering the dais, making footing a risky business at best.  Above, the huge carved head of the drake slumbers in its stony impassivity.  The great eyes are closed, each immaculately carved with rows of spikes along the rims of the eyelids.  Fans on either side are tucked gracefully along the dragon's jaws, reaching back toward the shoulders.  Steps continue a northeast ascent toward a narrow ledge at the beast's feet.
title: [Dais of Ice]
2648.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An elaborate throne sits before the swirling water of the pool.   The thing is so large it would dwarf the tallest giantman.  However, the huge shape of the stone drake behind it makes the chair look small and fragile.  It seems to be made of the same stone as that of the wyrm, and its ornamentation is a mantle of carved, interlocking sigils.  Incised upon the throne's backrest is a crown within a circle.
title: [The Dragon Sleeps]
2649.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Large spines along the neck are half laid back in a posture that accents the statue's somnolent pose.  The neck muscles are pronounced, making the carved scales undulate.  As a result, the footing here is hazardous at best, but the neck spines provide a welcome handhold.  The neck curves west toward the head, and east in a more dangerous climb, up the beast's back.
title: [Drake's Neck, Ice Shrine]
2650.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The drake's back is a mere span away from the ceiling, giving a panoramic view of the shrine and its central mass of ice.  Like the neck, the beast's back is ridged with spines that are dropped into a near-horizontal attitude.  The great wings are furled close to the body, and a finger-like claw is visible at the tip of each.
title: [Drake's Back, Ice Shrine]
2651.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The bunched muscles of the beast's haunch are partially obscured by the huge, closed wings.  A narrow passage between the body and wing leads down to the drake's foot.  To the east, the tail curls around like an ice-covered promenade, its furthest point obscured in shadow.
title: [Drake's Haunch, Ice Shrine]
2652.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The drake's toe is as big around as a dwarf's belly and twice again as long.  It culminates in a formidable, curved claw.  Standing here, one is prompted to contemplate just how vulnerable would be this perch, was the dragon to draw breath and awaken.
title: [Drake's Toe, Ice Shrine]
2653.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The spines characteristic of the stone drake's neck and back continue down the length of its tail, although here, the spikes are shorter and more barbarously sharp.  The prospect of carving stone into a point as keen as any rendered in steel is daunting, yet here a whole row of them stands like a honed ridge of deadly pikes.
title: [Drake's Tail, Ice Shrine]
2654.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The tip of the drake's tail concludes in a barbed horn that is poised directly over the rippling surface of the spring-warmed pool.  A temperate column of air rising from the water envelops the scaled extremity and leaves the stone free of ice, but slippery nonetheless from the constant moisture.
title: [Drake's Tail, Ice Shrine]
2655.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Monstrous brow ridges glower over blank, stone eyes.  Then the muzzle tapers down to ridged nostrils and a generously toothed mouth.  The monumental drake possesses a sense of tension, exhibited in each curve of carved muscle.  The level of sculpted detail is astounding, as if a living, breathing creature had been caught in slumber and sentenced to lie here for all eternity, imprisoned within its own magnificent form.
title: [Drake's Head, Ice Shrine]
2656.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Again, one is moved to marvel at the superb workmanship epitomized by this statue.  A lattice of delicate veins trace a pattern across the eyelid, making it seem that the eye could open at any moment.  Each masterfully rendered eyelash framing it is sheathed in ice, like frozen tears collected along the eye's fringe.
title: [Drake's Eye, Ice Shrine]
2657.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs grow more pitched and hazardous with each step.  To each side, sheer walls rise up toward the arched ceiling, their surfaces covered with archaic sigils punctuated with pictographs.  Many of these portray drakes, in a multitude of postures.
title: [Stairs of Ice]
2658.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the northwest, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  Above the course of steps, a dais is visible below a ridge.  Strange flickers of reflected light bounce off the icy walls above and around the dais, as if the low light were rebounding off water.  To the south, the huge, sculpted mountain of ice exudes a constant wave of brutal cold, as if it was exhaling the wilderness of rime encasing the ancient edifice.
title: [Platform of Ice]
2659.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ice coating the platform flows unbroken into the nave's huge iceberg, a seamless sweep of graceful spirals that eventually merge with a monumental figure towering above.  There, a dragon plummets from the sky, its wings trailing behind it like tattered streamers.  Icy shafts protrude from the drake's neck and body and rivulets of ice seep from the wounds.  The form hovers moments before impact, its features a study of agony and at the same time, resignation to the finality of its endless fall.
title: [Platform of Ice]
2660.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the northeast, a flight of steps leads up, so icy that climbing their hazardous incline seems an impossible feat.  This platform is totally encased in a frozen sheet that muffles sound and reflects light in a glistening shimmer.  Above the treacherous ascent, a ledge is visible - and towering above that, a monstrous, serpentine figure reclines, its head and tail forming a protective curve around the ice-sheathed dais.
title: [Platform of Ice]
2661.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The octagonal room boasts the familiar double columns standing guard around its walls, crowned with elaborately adorned capitals.  In the chamber's center stands a stone font.  Its base is supported with a spiral of small, carved dragonettes cavorting in a winged torrent that sweeps up from the floor.  A thin trickle of water from the font sends soft echoes bouncing off the columns, like the sound of a solitary brook.
title: [Stone Font, Ice Shrine]
2662.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The symmetry of the long aisle flanked by columns shifts as it veers to the northeast.   The high, inset windows stop as the hallway's curve is initiated, however, reflected light from the frozen mountain of ice shines in through the spaces between the interior columns, illuminating the colors of frescos decorating the exterior walls.  An alcove can be glimpsed to the northeast.

description: A walkway curves around the massive slab of ice crouched in the center of the nave, its crown hidden in the shadows of the tall, arched ceiling.  Where the flagstones meet the formation's foot, the rocks are cracked, yet they still retain their uniform plane.  The sculpture changes as the walkway circles it, transforming from a single drake to the contorted forms of two of the great beasts in flight.  Their bodies are twisted about each other, with only the four grand wings free to maintain flight.
paths: Obvious exits: north, southeast, west, northwest
title: [Dance of the Drakes, Sunset]
2664.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave, with its omnipotent ice sculpture.  The walls within the long, curved hallway are tall and inset with narrow, rectangular windows placed high, so that beams of light play down on the ice-covered flagstones in distinct ovals.  The repeated columns march away into the shadows, creating a steady rhythm of modulating, ice-covered surfaces, caught in the grip of the implacable cold.

description: The alcove is octagonal, its perimeter surrounded by a row of double columns boasting highly decorated capitals supporting likewise elegantly carved entablatures.  On the eastern wall is a cistern, into which drops of water fall from somewhere in the shadows of the high ceiling.  The droplets send a stately drum of sound into the chamber's hollow silence.
title: [Sunset Alcove, Ice Shrine]
2666.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The chamber's center aisle is spanned by an impressive pointed barrel-vault, emphasizing the ceiling's lofty height.  Light falls at the north end, illuminating a twisted form of ice so large, it reaches to the ceiling, as if lifting arms of ice in supplication.  Where the massive ice form begins, side aisles branch to the northwest and northeast.  Curiously, the frozen formation resembles a gigantic dragon's head, its mouth open to reveal curved teeth taller than a giantman.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, southeast, southwest, northwest
title: [Chamber of the Maw, Ice Shrine]
2667.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The aisle works its way around the glacial mass, growing narrow then wide with the permutations of the ice.  The single, massive drake guarding the nave's approach has transmuted into a large adult, surrounded by a brace of smaller wyrms flying in perfect symmetry beneath the adult's outstretched wings.  The three spiral up towards the ceiling high above in a silent, joyful dance, looking as if they are caught in the space of a heartbeat, frozen for the ages.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, east, southwest
title: [Dance of the Drakes, Sunrise]
2668.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Although the octagonal chamber isn't small, the aisle through it is crowded and difficult to navigate.  The room's center is dominated by a large sculpture depicting a pile of treasure so lifelike, only the dull surface of the stone reveals it as a fabrication.  Piles of exactingly carved coins spread in all directions, punctuated with strands of pearls and all manner of jewelry and fanciful armor.  On its summit rests a drake, rendered in a lazy and contented repose.
title: [Dragon's Hoard, Ice Shrine]
2669.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The vaulted hallway veers to the northwest, marked by an increase of shadow in that direction as the reflections from the ice behemoth are less ambient.   This part of the hallway is notable for its rich frescos that alternate with the columns on the aisle's exterior walls.  Overhead, the ceiling's elevated arch is as graceful as a heron's wing poised for flight.
title: [Vaulted Aisle East, Ice Shrine]
2670.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The colonnaded aisle traverses the central nave.  Rectangular windows set high in the tall exterior walls throw oval pools of light down onto the frozen flagstones.  On either side, rows of columns stretch away into the shadowy interior like silent guardians made of ice.  To the west, glimpses of the huge frozen formation alternate with the double row of columns.

description: The octagonal alcove is surrounded by a row of double columns.  On the west wall, between an arch of alternating red and black stone and a high doorway, stands a frieze of carved felines.  Three pairs of lions rampant, each with hind paws planted on the ground and forepaws on the back of his companion stand in the icy shadows like silent guardians.  They depict an attitude of strength at first glance, but the curling tongues of ice-covered flame licking at their backs impart a whiff of evil.
title: [Sunrise Alcove, Ice Shrine]
2672.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs culminate in an entry hall, little more than a glorified landing replete with sculpted stone.  Stairwells curving down to the southeast and southwest converge at a double column surmounted by capitals carved in high relief.  Opposite the trumeau, two arches, crafted of alternating dark and reddish-toned granite blocks, open to the northeast and northwest.  Over every surface, the relentless sheath of ice gives a reflective coating that is as lovely as it is precarious.
title: [Domed Entry Hall, Hill of Ice]
2673.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs curve up toward the west, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  The stone of the outside walls is heavily carved in bas-relief.  Overhead, the ceiling is a distant, shadowy pool of darkness, but the intricate detail of the carved walls can be glimpsed reaching past the point of sight in a rich landscape of embellishment.
title: [East Stair, Hill of Ice]
2674.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An anteroom is flanked with arches to the left and right.  The walls are dark stone, rising overhead to a peak that follows the curve of the vaulting.   Footing is hazardous, owing to the sheet of ice coating everything with its brittle, glistening veneer.  Through the arches, courses of stairs can be glimpsed, composed of the same dark stone and filled with shadows.

until: A deep grinding sound echoes through the sepulchral halls of the shrine.  Slowly, the stone door begins to rise, drawing upwards into the top of its frame.  Inch by inch it crawls, steadily ascending to reveal light beyond.  Within a short time, it has withdrawn completely, leaving an open doorway that beckons you outside
Gathering your strength, you give the brass ring a mighty tug, but it will not budge an inch

title: [Antechamber, Hill of Ice]
2675.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs curve up toward the east, dark with shadow and treacherous with ice.  Along the outside wall, friezes follow the ascent, providing a rich panorama of dense detail that adds to the menace of the ice, adding the temptation of studying the carved stone instead of the ice-covered steps.
title: [West Stair, Hill of Ice]
2676.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Whirling snow is tinted an incongruous rose color by the low arctic light.  Then, a lull in the wind offers a breathtaking vision!  Mantled by the storm's flurry, a monument perches on the mountain's top, immense in size and of extraordinary beauty.  Columns march across the facade, their tops almost lost in the clouds, framing a colossal door.  Beside the door, a shining gold crown is mounted in bas-relief, erratically throwing out brilliant reflections as light fights through the fog to caress it.

description: Clouds merge with blowing snow and an uncertain horizon.  Courageous patches of light randomly filter through the wind, sparkling off the frozen path and then fraying back into the haze as if devoured.  The way curves to the northwest around a wall of stone, encrusted with ice that almost obscures its carved surface.  To the northeast, a trail, little more than packed ice, snakes across a narrow ledge which is almost obscured by a dense shower of blowing snow.

description: Ice and snow whirl around in a shifting dance, caressing the mountainside then racing away in a cloud which leaves a majestic view of the arctic plains in its wake.  In the far distance, the tiny forms of a couple of polar bears cavort in a patch of sunlight.  The bears roll and tumble in play, until they are swallowed up along with the horizon in the persistent blizzard.  A trail winds to the northwest and southwest in a dangerous bend that traverses gaps and stone outcroppings.

description: Powdery snow blankets the tableland near the northern end of a high pass, glinting in the frigid starlight like diamond dust.  A pale stone roadway, nearly concealed by the shiftless drifts, climbs to follow the rise of the terrain, delving northward toward a shrouded mountain in the distance.  Hardy pines dotting the landscape leaven the sea of white with rare glimpses of rich greenery, standing proud and tall despite the weight of the snowfall.
title: [The Giantroad, Pass]
34031.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Broken and devoured by time, a road of pale stone loses itself in deep snow as the highland plain gives way to a craggy arete.  To the north, the niveous thread of cultivated roadway reappears as it curves to avoid the white-clad slope of an abutting mountain.  Wind wails through the passes, low, mournful, and musical at once.  It sways the branches of nearby pines into a slow, funereal dance.
title: [The Giantroad, Arete]
34032.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Undermined by the relentless prying of snowmelt, a face of the adjacent mountain has sheared away, collapsing into rubble that blocks much of the ancient white roadway.  Revealed by the rockslide, a vast stone figure strains from the wounded mountainside, one cracked hand outstretched as if reaching skyward.  Much of the colossal form is still trapped within the unyielding rock of the mountain.
title: [The Giantroad, Watcher]
34033.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Judging from the copious jags of rubble poking out of the deep snows, the tower that stands near the western edge of the pale stone road once stretched high into the sky.  It has been brought low, and all that remains is a broken ruin as squat and useless as a spent candle.  What remains of the arched entrance suggests that it was once an entryway of staggering height.
title: [The Giantroad, Shattered Tower]
34034.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The broken remains of the ancient white road travel up to the jagged rim of a steep gorge. Though ancient, the carvings on the bridge are deep-graven, depicting preternaturally beautiful figures in a variety of scenes.  Beyond the bridge rises a mountain, its peak lost in the clouds overhead.
title: [The Giantroad, Gorge]
34035.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Accessible only by the virtue of a colossal stone bridge, a broad ledge juts out of one of the lowest faces of a lofty mountain that stretches into the swirling clouds above. title: [The Giantroad, Crystalmount]
34036.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The faintest hint of starlight filters through a vast yawning breach in the western wall of the cavern, but the tenuous curtain of radiance does little to throw back the surrounding gloom. Reflected ripples off of the water do not reach the cavern's distant ceiling.
title: [Crystalmount, Cavern]
34037.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Away from the light of the sun or moons, hints of luminescence thrive within the blackness of the cavern. Puddles of snowmelt make for a treacherous path through the cumbrous lightlessness.
title: [Crystalmount, Cavern]
34038.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Firelight from the west throws back the shadows, illuminating makeshift shelters erected from logs and stitched skins.  The crude dwellings are huge, but they are dwarfed by the scope of the cavern, the lichen-clad ceiling of which seems impossibly distant.  Great weapons, clubs and axes too large for most humanoids, lean against a near wall, crafted from steel, pine, and pitch.  Sacks of stout leather are heaped together and are brimming with dried provisions.
title: [Crystalmount, Giant Camp]
34039.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flames leap and roar from an immense bonfire built beneath a gap in the cavern ceiling through which the light of the distant stars beckons. The bonfire is fed mostly with pine and spruce, which fill the cavern with the crisp effervescence of burning resin, but neither wood explains the strange bluish cast to the roaring flames.

34040.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glowing curtains of lichen cast strange illumination over a flat cavern wall that is covered with ancient etchings. At the center of the wall, a pair of round double doors gleams in the unearthly light, golvern rivets more brilliant than the precious veil iron from which they are predominantly wrought.  The vast entryway is dozens of feet high at its zenith.
title: [Crystalmount, Ancient Seal]
34041.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34042.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide gallery curves in a gentle crescent, following the southern wall of the cavernous hall. A pathway is formed of cubed cerulean glaes set into the black stone of the gallery walk, intricate golden inlay forming a border between the two. 34043.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Crystalhall, South Gallery]
34044.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34045.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Richly inlaid with cerulean glaes and braided spirals of gold, a dark bridge arcs out over a fathomless black chasm toward a crystalline dais at the cavern's center. title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
34046.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Great steps, with smaller ones carved beside them for ease of passage, bridge the space between the southern gallery and another along the cavern's western edge. 34047.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

34048.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ornate gold and silver inlay arcs outward in splendorous rays from a pair of double doors in the western wall. 34049.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The brilliantly inlaid bridge stretches toward a crystalline dais at the center of the cavern. title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
34050.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A painstakingly detailed relief looms over the bend of the gallery as its crescent mirrors the curve of the cavern wall. 34052.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Crystalhall, North Gallery]
34053.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A translucent vein of rich cerulean glaes runs evenly down the central length of the bridge as it arcs over the dizzying chasm, chased by inlaid gold. Hoarbeam rails flank the bridge to keep unwary travelers from the cavernous depths to either side.
title: [Crystalhall, Dais Bridge]
34054.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The great dais at the center of the cavern is a sparkling hexagonal confection of icy blue glaes.  A constellation of golden flecks winks from within the depths of the stone. 34055.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Overhead, ancient chandeliers hold candles beyond count. 34057.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

title: [Crystalhall, East Gallery]
34058.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A silver-fringed banner of stoutfoot wool hangs from the western wall, its field embroidered with a rampant mule.  Before it stands a petrified wood desk and a comfortable chair. title: [Crystalhall, Suite]
34060.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Opalescent stone clashes with dark, igneous rock along the smooth-hewn walls, forming beautiful interlocking shapes reminiscent of a thicket of brambles. title: [Crystalhall, Chamber]
34061.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Cerulean pillars of glaes march evenly away from the doors, proceeding down the torchlit hallway. 34062.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hallway comes to the end in a curved niche featuring a sprawling mural, the naturally rich colors of the pigments augmented by gemstone dust and gilt. Nacreous bands of metal cavort across the walls and frame the murals, seeming to glow faintly with their own inner light.
title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]

description: A rounded niche at the end of the hallway features a mural of monumental size that depicts a chaotic battle. title: [Crystalhall, Sanctuary]

description: A strange heat comes from the back of the building to the west, melting the snow around the black and white granite pavers into a fluid slush. Across from the monumental figures are storefronts offering blades, staves, and bows, cheerfully engaging in the arms trade as if heedless to their colossal overseers.
title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
34617.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Smoke belches, black and thick, from the limestone chimney of a smithy hunching beneath the outer wall of the town.  Framed by a pair of old weeping willows with round lanterns hung from their branches, the shop stands at the end of a neat lane that winds beneath the stooped trees.  Several carts of dark metal ingots rest outside the smithy's arched entrance.
title: [Sablecross, Gauntlet Row]
34618.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Paint in autumnal hues cavorts along the dark slate walls, illuminating the etched forms of prowling cats.  They congregate to either side of a high gate of black steel with golden ornamentation.  Low stone buildings with dark windows huddle to either side of the street, casting long shadows over the paving stones.  The road splits into three wide lanes that proceed southward, the southeastern fork descending toward a bustling bazaar flourishing beneath the eastern wall.
title: [Sablecross, The Gate of Cats]
34619.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Near a domed dwelling at the avenue's eastern edge stands an elegant statue of dusky golden marble.  The monument is carved into the shape of a hunting caracal, its artistry capturing in lifelike detail the predatory grace of the feline's tensed musculature.  From the south wafts alder smoke in puffy white clouds, the earthy sweetness mostly masking an unpleasant, sharp melange that it accompanies.
title: [Sablecross, Caracal Avenue]
34620.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A riot of knotted silken scarves flaps in the breeze, suspended over the roadway from hooks on a pair of opposing limestone buildings.  As it winds to the southeast, the lane widens to accommodate a dazzling spectrum of stalls and pavilions that have joined the multifarious businesses huddling to either side of the path.  Carts creak along, but much of the traffic is on foot, clustering about roadside jongleurs and hoarse-voiced hawkers straining to be heard over the din.
title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
34621.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A grandiose countinghouse with marble pillars stands back from the surging throngs of the bazaar.  The old edifice's verdigris bronze roofing and elegant limestone facade contrasts sharply with the multifarious colors of nearby stalls.  Above the arched entrance hangs a heavy bronze sign that depicts a pair of balanced scales.
title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
34622.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stately brick brokerage with a viridian awning has wide windows of smoked glass that permit only glimpses of movement within.  It stands in the shade of the outer wall, flanked by manicured pomegranate trees that are heavy-laden with plump red fruit.  The candlelight that flickers from the open door is welcoming and warm, suggesting a spot of solace away from the raucous crowds of the Giltroad's bazaar.
title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
34623.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The savory promise of cooked meat beckons on the breeze, escorted by the aromas of exotic spices in a tantalizing melange.  Spicers and food vendors alike crowd the eastern side of the street, but its western verge is occupied by a lapidary's shop.  Hanging over its dark blue door is an etched bronze sign depicting a multifaceted gemstone.
title: [Sablecross, The Giltroad]
34624.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Twisting tentacles of bronze frame a vast gate with sinuous bars wrought into the shapes of smoky tendrils.  To either side, high walls of tenebrous stone are painted with green wisps of smoke enshrouding writhing humanoid figures with lithe bodies and lovely shapes.  The gate opens onto a winding cobblestone lane that proceeds into the heart of a populous district of tall brick and stone buildings.
title: [Sablecross, The Grasping Gate]
34625.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wrought iron lampposts are spaced to either side of the roadway, but they are unlit and the glass of their lamps is badly stained with soot.  The lane winds beneath the facades of baleful buildings the color of smoke, crowded by passersby and a somber mix of coaches, wagons, and carriages drawn by black horses and other grim beasts of burden.  A faint hint of perfume and tobacco smoke threads through the smells of the throng.
title: [Sablecross, Thresher Street]
34626.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Old brownstone homes with ivy-strangled walls stand as silent judges along the roadside, their quiet watchfulness contrasting sharply with the bedlam of the marketplace to the northwest.  The lane is a broad and even march of squared paving stones that are neatly fitted together.  Weeping willows stoop to either side, standing tall between scriveners' shops and booksellers.
title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
34627.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Most of the businesses along the lush green stretch of the bend are of the scholarly variety, ranging from several stores selling academic texts to an alchemist's workshop with its windows open to display brightly colored bottles.  A gently burbling brook spills from a crack in a nearby hillock's crown to meander alongside the cobblestone road.  Its music fills the silence, crystalline and sweet, unaccompanied save for the occasional footsteps of passersby.
title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
34628.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A cold pall hangs over the stretch of cobblestone road, which treads uneasily beneath the shadow of the township's outer wall.  Bounded by the road, a lichyard occupies a series of rolling slopes clad in downy green grass.  Headstones, pale as bare bones, breach out of the soil, but many are graced with bright flowers and other mementos.  The yard is bordered by a fence of black wrought iron that frames an arched entrance.
title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
34629.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A smaller row branches off of the main thoroughfare, heading northward past a clothier's with broad bay windows.  Smoked glass and silken curtains the color of the night sky guard the shop's secrets, though the open front door allows welcoming music and the scent of burning frankincense to escape.  The ironwood door is inlaid with a glinting crescent moon of black opal.
title: [Sablecross, Hollow Bend]
34630.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road splits around a large grey marble fountain that takes the form of a parliament of owls.  The stone birds' beaks wings are widespread, and their beaks are opened wide, fountaining a spray of water that is transformed into a cascade of prismatic droplets by the sunlight.  The resplendent display of color is in stark contrast to the muted tones of the stone facades on businesses nearest the roadside.
title: [Sablecross, Strix Road]
34631.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cobblestone roadway proceeds beneath a vast portcullis of black iron decorated by golden chains as it marches into the yard of the basalt-walled citadel.  Black against the brightness of the skies, the central spire of the complex points forebodingly heavenward.  Armed, dark figures along the walls stand vigilant watch over the entry, the wind stirring their concealing garments and dark cloaks.  A black walnut message board stands near to the entrance, obviously a frequent roost for ravens.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion's Shadow]
34632.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flames burn in recessed niches along the basalt base of an imposing spire stretching into the heavens above the yard.  Guarded by high curtain walls joining the outer towers, the courtyard is a bustle of activity.  Clanging hammers ring out from forges while aurochs drawing carts engage in uneasy lowing that is mostly drowned out by the din of the crowd.  Merchants' guards unload their cargo while servants in charcoal garb hasten past to their tasks.  A vast black iron portcullis offers egress to the street outside.
title: [The Bastion, Yard]
34633.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the southwest, the high rooftops of temple complexes stretch skyward, but none are so tall as the skyscraping spire at the center of the citadel to the northeast.  Rising high above the basalt walls enclosing the complex, the spire is a towering construct of shadowed stone that seems to scrape the bellies of the clouds.  Its shadow stretches over the town, black and foreboding.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34634.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rook Boulevard blends into the road encircling the citadel at the village's center.  Steepled manses give way to smaller homes and businesses content to huddle in the shadow of the walls around the central spire's base.  Near to the walls is a stand of strangler figs that have found hardy purchase in a craggy section of the greenway, their boles tangled about the corpses of trees they have consumed.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34635.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tall rookery, crooked and black, leans perilously over the roadside, casting a dread shadow across the smooth-worn cobbles.  It rises far above the thick green canopy of the encroaching trees and a story higher than most of the manses lurking beyond the greenery.  The outer sills of the rookery's cavernous windows are stained white with the leavings of countless birds.
title: [Sabelcross, Rook Boulevard]
34636.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Eerie multicolored light wafts from wardings carved along the high wall at the center of town.  It filters through the dark, tangled boles of strangler figs in the greenway below the fortifications.  Carts roll along the cobblestones, hauling metal ingots toward the forges of the Canton of Hammers, drawn by great black aurochs.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34637.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls encircling the base of the Bastion are high and strong, formed from great blocks of basalt that are fitted together so closely that the seams between stones are difficult to detect.  They are dwarfed by the great spire itself, a looming black talon that scrapes at the sky.  Neither businesses nor homes trespass onto the side of the curving street occupied by the fortifications, but flowers and grasses flourish in the greenways beneath the walls.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34638.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tannery stands far from the other structures nearby, but its singularly vile melange of tanning fluids and animal hides billows out over the cobblestone street in noisome eddies.  In the shadow of the shop burns a brazier stacked with alder logs.  Their pale smoke is laden with mild, loamy sweetness that almost manages to hold the wretched stench at bay.  Several other shops along the stretch have censers of incense burning in their windows or aromatic nosegays hung before their doors.
title: [Sablecross, Caracal Avenue]
34639.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Multicolored light bleeds in cool hues from warding glyphs etched into the surface of the grim basalt walls defending the Bastion's base.  As if oblivious to the imposing battlements above, patches of mournbloom and bleeding heart flourish in cultivated banks at the base of the wall.  The air is cold, as if the shadow of the great spire above has leached the warmth from the surroundings.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34640.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Stalks of monkshood sway in the shadows beneath the great citadel at the heart of the burg.  Their ghostly blue flowers and bright green petals are a splash of color against the bleakness of the tenebrous basalt wall behind them.  Tall brick buildings frame the roadway as it descends to the east, retreating into the sprawl beyond the great spire and its walled base.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34641.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chatter drifts down from the high balconies of brick buildings to both sides of the lane, the dark shapes of which leave only a narrow strip of daylight overhead.  Sunlight glows tenuously off of horse-drawn stagecoaches that rattle over the cobblestone street, but the sparse pedestrian traffic along the road's edges are consigned to shadow.  The windows of the businesses above a barrister's office are dark and the chambers beyond them shrouded by curtains in lurid reds and other bright, jeweled hues.
title: [Sablecross, Thresher Street]
34642.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Grim, armed figures in dark garb patrol the battlements overhead, but judging from the glowing wards scribed on the foreboding walls, they are far from the sole defense of the citadel at the town's heart.  Clustered along the wall is a stand of thriving poisonwood trees with nettle and nightshade growing at their bases.  To the southeast, the slate-roofed buildings of the Hushed Span linger in characteristic quiet.
title: [Sablecross, Bastion Circle]
34643.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Banners of charcoal silk fringed in dark golden brocade hang overhead, emblazoned with a dark tower wreathed in flames in sullen sunset hues.  They ripple in air currents rising from the vast hearths that heat the cavernous chamber.  A broad runner of lush velvet in the same hues proceeds toward an arched pair of ebony double doors with leaping flames of fireleaf inlay.  Twin suits of armor, many feet too tall to be worn by a human, flank the doors, their black ora breastplates winking in the fireglow.
title: [The Bastion, Antechamber]
34644.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shadebinders in cinerious garb flank the doors and guard immense staircases of dark marble that climb toward the upper reaches of the Bastion, twining and interlacing at fantastical landings overhead.  A banquet table of inlaid widowwood stretches before a fiery hearth of grim stone fashioned to resemble a demon's yawning maw.  Sumptuously laden with bone porcelain, crystal goblets, and golden cutlery, the table is flanked to either side by ornate seats of ebony that are heavily clad in gilt.
title: [The Bastion, Great Hall]
34645.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The scent of old parchment and oiled leather fills the office's reception area.  Legal tomes in a variety of styles, bindings, and languages line bookshelves along the walls, and scarlet and black tapestries with gold embroidery hang between the furnishings.  Near to a paneled ebony door, an elm reception desk with widowwood panels stands guard, laden with a neat arrangement of inkpots, quills, and papers.
title: [Fanghorn and Hoof, Reception]
34646.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lush velvet curtains are drawn over the office's windows, allowing in only the faintest glow of sunlight.  The day's radiance is confined to feeble pools near each window, so the duty of lighting the chamber is left to branching candelabras sitting on a large writing desk and atop a bookshelf near the door.  The chair behind the desk is almost a throne.  It is upholstered in dark red leather and its bloodwood frame clad in gilt filigree.
title: [Fanghorn and Hoof, Chambers]
34647.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The savory aroma of roasting meat beckons on the breeze, tantalizing and teasing from the lofty, arched windows of a thriving restaurant at the end of the row.  Along the flagstone patio, fine metal chains hold aloft a series of glass lanterns.  Though unlit, they refract the sunlight in dazzling rainbowed patterns over the outdoor seats and tables.  Atop the steepled roof, silk pennants in amber and dusky gold flutter proudly, their fabric embroidered with stylized lions.
title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
34648.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chandeliers bathe the entryway of the restaurant in warm lighting that awakens a tawny glow in the fine furnishings.  Beneath the light of the candles, the lifelike glass eyes of a hinterboar trophy mounted on the wall over the entrance glitter keenly.  The host's stand is carved from golden maple and is placed near the entrance, keeping the host in ready view of a smoked glass door leading into a private lounge.
title: [The Lion's Share, Host Stand]
34649.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Secured by a smoked glass door, the lounge is an intimate space that smells faintly of tobacco and leather.   A number of cushioned leather seats sit opposite one another, separated by a smoked glass table with a frosted pattern at its edges that resembles interlocking talons.  Within reach of the table, a burled ash humidor holds cigars and matches.
title: [The Lion's Share, Lounge]
34650.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Soft, swaying grasses carpet the incline between the meandering row and the walls of the citadel above, leaving ample space for elegant brownstone homes and a scattering of storefronts.  Among the tidy procession of businesses, an apothecary's shop with a squared chimney stands out for the garlands of herbs strung from its eaves.  Bay laurel and vervain are woven together in a colorful display of yellow and pink flowers over the front door, which is etched with a stylized mortar and pestle.
title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
34651.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lemon balm and lavender overflow the planters hung by the window of the shop.  The sweet scent from their profusion of flowers fills the small shop and is only the foremost of the multifarious herbal scents in the air.  Nosegays and herb bundles hang from the walls and occupy several small display tables in the cozy space.  Behind a high poisonwood counter, more dangerous herbs are kept, including sprigs of nightshade, clusters of white deathwort, and hemlock.
title: [Snakeroot's Apothecary, Store]
34652.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Blossoming flaeshorn vines climb the walls of a marble enchanter's atelier.  Intricate symbols have been carved into the dark stone, following the natural crimson veins that travel through the marble in a way that makes them difficult to follow with the eye.  Carved steps lead up to a heavy, reinforced door.  Windows of stained glass--bold cobalt, vibrant cardinal red, and rich burnt umber--give not a hint as to the workshop's interior, but their panes shine as if lit from within.
title: [Sablecross, Mute Row]
34653.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tiny golden sigils are set into the surface of the marble block walls of the atelier, also gracing a rectangular marble slab at the center of the chamber.  The sunlight streaming into the chamber is heavily stained with the colors of the windows, a collection of cobalt, scarlet, and burnt umber shades.  An interlocking pattern of gold and bronze chains is set into the floor and encircles the slab's base.
title: [The Spellforge, Atelier]
34654.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavy velvet curtains of charcoal silk with green fringes obscure the shop's windows, leaving the work of lighting it to a series of candles in pierced bronze lantern holders.  Gowns and coats on mannequins along the perimeters of the showroom suggest a singular talent for the tailor's craft, embodying a variety of styles, fabrics, and cuts.  Several hooks hold completed garments, but it appears that the predominance are made to order.  A grey and green door leads to a studio set off from the main room.
title: [Silk and Shade, Shop]
34655.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spools of fine fabric hang on a large rack near the door leading into the small studio.  A neat workbench holds spools of tailor's tape, pins, and shears, all pristinely arranged.  On the sill of the sole window in the room sits a fresh-cut rose with petals the color of flame.
title: [Silk and Shade, Studio]
34656.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Even rows of black marble tombstones march along the soft green grasses near the entrance of the lichyard, only halted in their precise procession by the roots of dark-boled bloodwoods dotting the grounds.  The cool breeze carries distant birdsong and the occasional creaking of the cemetery gate, but otherwise it is as if a pall of silence hangs over the graves.  A mausoleum resting in the shadow of the fence is grander than the surrounding tombstones and is intricately carved with bas-reliefs.
title: [Sablecross, Lichyard]
34657.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Brightly colored bottles catch the sunlight streaming through the wide bay windows facing the street.  They cast fragments of bright color--scarlet, green, and indigo--across the other wares in the showroom, an eclectic collection of wands, amulets, potions, and other arcane implements.  Atop a pedestal of carved ebony, a glass display holds a sliver of plinite the color of absinthe, but the crystal is spiderwebbed with deep cracks.
title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Showroom]
34658.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: More of a workroom than a sales parlor, the room smells faintly of acrid catalysts and burning sulphur.  The likely source of the odor is a series of spiraled tubes, beakers, and vials full of strange bubbling liquids that sits behind the narrow teak sales counter.  Several bottles holding quicksilver, oil of antimony, and spirit of hartshorn gleam from a shelf that would require a ladder to reach, their identities obvious from neat labels beneath each.
title: [Eldritch Elixirs, Acquisitions]
34659.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rows of tombstones become less even as the ground grows more hilly.  A pauper's gravestone, devoid of ornamentation, is spiderwebbed through with cracks, but most of the memorials are well-tended.  Several have bouquets of mournblooms and other flowers left before them.  No offerings sit before a small black monument near the furthest verges of the lichyard, but it is heavily ornamented with the forms of entangled serpents.
title: [Sablecross, Lichyard]
34660.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In a glazed pot by the rear window of the shop, a tuft of moon sedge soaks up the daylight.  Several cots, reasonably comfortable but simple in make, are arranged neatly in the room.  Healing herbs, several gemstones, and a roll of bandages sit on a folded fabric square atop a small table near the window.  The acrid scent of astringent hangs faintly in the air.
title: [Snakeroot's Apothecary, Cures]
34661.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Trophies of the hunt hang from mounting boards on the slate walls of the restaurant alongside spears and bows that have the appearance of great age.  Serving staff bustle around tables and booths, carrying gold-chased silver platters laden with delicacies.  Through the melange of dishes, the savory aromas of roasting venison and garlic win through, but they are only a few of the tantalizing aromas promised by the kitchens.  Some glass-paneled doors lead out onto the patio, where more seating is available.
title: [The Lion's Share, Dining Room]
34662.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fine metal chains hang over the patio, suspending a series of glass lanterns.  Though unlit, they catch the daylight and refract it in a constellation of rainbowed shards that illuminate the surfaces of the round tables that occupy the patio.  A quiet but picturesque street runs along one side of the patio, while on the other, some glass-paneled doors lead into the rustic opulence of the restaurant.
title: [The Lion's Share, Patio]
34663.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Songbirds pattern the wallpaper near to the wooden table, their plumage coming in a variety of colors and styles.  The tabletop itself is carved with a preening pheasant with its tailfeathers spread in a vainglorious display.  A spray of brightly colored feathers rings a small lamp at the center.
title: [Pleasant Pheasant Table]
34664.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Prowling lions adorn the wallpaper near the wooden table, their eyes intent as if they are circling prey.  Carved into the iridescent mother-of-pearl tabletop is a roaring lion stands atop a jutting precipice of stone.  A small tiger's eye obelisk serves as the table's centerpiece.
title: [Pride's Bounty Table]
34665.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The wallpaper near the table depicts a wild-looking man with lambent eyes like those of a wolf.  Woodland spirits cavort over the ornately carved tabletop, engaged in acts of play and mischief.  Pendant lamps resembling chunks of raw stone cast warm illumination over the area, and the air holds the subtle fragrance of wildflowers.
title: [Woodland Spirit Table]
34666.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glass displays spaced throughout the room hold samples of the lapidary's art: tourmalines fashioned in the shapes of teardrops, diamonds cut to enhance their splendorous white fire, and firedrops winking like solid flame scattered across beds of black velvet.  Though not large, the shop appears prosperous, its floor patterned with porcelain tiles forming a pyramid of charcoal and lilac squares.  A fresco on the eastern wall portrays a plump, long-haired lapidary plying his trade with a hammer and chisel.
title: [Vorwyn's Lapidary, Gallery]
34667.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: It is dim inside the shop, but not dark.  Glimaerstone lamps are hung along the walls, their light trained on a number of glass display cases arranged around the large room.  The cases are mostly empty, though there are half a dozen items within them, mostly trinkets and baubles of little apparent value.  The floor is covered in a rich wall-to-wall carpet the color of burgundy wine, and a velvet curtain of the same color masks a doorway leading eastward.
title: [Gaunt's Run, Showroom]
34668.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Bronze braziers hang from the central beam of the ceiling by glittering metal chains, warming the air and casting the surroundings in firelight.  Guards stand ready by the double doors of the entrance, armor and weapons mostly concealed by dark cloaks.  Columns proceed northward, flanking a gold-tasseled scarlet runner as it proceeds toward the clerks' desks.
title: [Grigg's Countinghouse, Lobby]
34669.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Separated from the commotion of the bazaar by a long alleyway, the bend is flanked by stately shops and older homes.  An elegant fence of spiraled dark iron bars extends along the southern side of the street, and at its center is an arched black gate with golden flourishes.  Orchids flourish along the perimter of a sprawling terrace on the other side, and beyond the yard awaits an expansive alabaster bathhouse.
title: [Sablecross, Silkbend]
34670.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Copper-bound planters stake out the edges of the flagstone terrace.  Orchids grow in profusion in the raised beds, the riot of blooms ranging in hues from snowy white to startling fuchsia.  Cloying sweetness from scented oils drifts from the double-door entrance of a capacious marble bathhouse, which reveals an opulent interior lit by candles.  The stone is predominantly cream-hued, but has flourishes of richer ash rose traveling through it in striking veins.  An arched black gate leads back out onto the road.
title: [The Anshelin Baths, Terrace]
34671.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The railing of the upper balcony on a nearby manor house dangles a single scarlet kerchief that matches the dwelling's red-limned door.  Heavy velvet curtains shroud the windows and those of the carriages parked in its courtyard.  Opposite the manse is a large open-air theater with a thatched roof over its circumference.  Lampposts stand to either side of the path leading to the playhouse.
title: [Sablecross, Silkbend]
34672.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of carved wooden seats are arrayed before the raised stage, though there are cordoned standing areas for those too tardy or too poor to win themselves a chair.  Though a thatched roof covers a portion of the house and stage, the center of the building is open to the sunlit sky.  Shimmering curtains of rich emerald velvet hang to either side of the stage, held open by golden braids.  A painted green door accesses the theater's backstage.
title: [Shadowplay Theater, Seating]
34673.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wooden beams crisscross the low roof of the backstage space, which is a bit cramped but tidy.  Desks with attached mirrors sit along the walls, each vanity laden with pots of face paint and lipstick in a rainbow of colors.  Several have wigs hung from pegs along their sides, and though most are the color of natural hair, a few come in vivid greens, pinks, and purples.  An emerald green curtain separates the small room from the stage, and a painted green door leads out into the theater.
title: [Shadowplay Theater, Backstage]
34674.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rose bushes line the greenway encircling a small court at the street's end, suffusing the air with their velvety perfume.  Benches along the court's exterior provide respite, though they and the cobblestones are littered with vivid crimson petals.
