34730.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Flanked by torches, the arched entrance of the structure opens out onto a well-tended garden dominated by sage bushes.  The torches hang in elaborate bronze sconces wrought to resemble partially unfurled scrolls.  The wall opposite the entrance features a glinting mosaic of jeweled tesserae depicting a man holding a burning brand before a kneeling throng.  Waves of intense heat distort the air around an amber-inlaid grey marble arch at the mosaic's center, making its edges shimmer and dance as if alive.
title: [The Archive, Vestibule]
34731.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Heavy chains of dull golden metal are riveted to the ceiling and walls of the expansive atrium.  They cruelly enmesh the statue of a raw-boned older man, suspending his form above a sea of dancing flames roaring from a stone-walled pit.  The heat of the flames makes the air of the cavernous chamber shimmer and warp, and the stones of the wall seem to writhe in the inferno.  Opposite the arch leading to the edifice's vestibule, a corridor proceeds northward before branching off to the west.
title: [The Archive, Radiance's Price]
34732.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sage bushes thrive in the shadows of the limestone walls enclosing the meditation garden of the library.  The dry, herbal scent is strong in the air, lingering over the grounds like incense.  Flagstones wind between tufts of moon sedge, weaving beneath an ornamental arch of grey marble that is shot through with striking green and wan yellow veins.  Near the eastern gate of the compound, a statue of a elderly man stands near the path, holding a flame aloft in one gnarled hand.
title: [The Profane Archive, Garden]
34733.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two temples, alike in their black stone construction, stand opposite one another at a bend in the road shaded by immense yew trees.  One shrine is a stygian marble building beyond a metallic wall of interlocking hexagons.  Spidersilk threads stretch across the openings in the metal, glistening like spun silver, and an octet of garnet eyes is inlaid into the lintel over the gate.  The arch leading to the second, a smaller, blocky building, is adorned with a bleached skull with a crack down the center.
title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
34734.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A squared basalt arch marks the entrance to the yard of a small temple of shadowy stone.  Planters of neatly tended foxglove, nightshade, and deathwort are crafted from planks of dark wood, their careful cultivation suggesting the work of a precise and skilled gardener.  Before the entrance, pale flagstones form a cracked skull symbol that stands out amid the pale green grasses.
title: [The Slayer's Den, Yard]
34735.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Skulls line alcoves along the walls of the temple's antechamber.  Some are darkened by age and riddled with jagged cracks, while others are clearly more recent acquisitions.  Haloed by candlelight, the alabaster statue of a small man with a wiry build stands at the chamber's center, his dancing shadow stretching almost to the entrance.  A bundle of foxglove lies heaped at his feet alongside offerings of coin and incense.
title: [The Slayer's Den, Entryway]
34736.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Spiderwebs glint silver in the daylight that creeps through the branches of crooked birches enclosing the temple's yard.  The silken webs stretch between the trees and entangle a gate of ebon metal along the plot's perimeter, though the noise of the abounding street is muffled and distant.  Dark flagstones offer a path through the creeping undergrowth toward a dark stone vault nestled deep within the thickly clustered trees.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Garden]
34737.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tiny black arachnids writhe over the cragged surface of the cave walls, and in the light from the web-rimmed entrance, their bodies seem a shifting sea of quickened onyx.  The surreptitious sussurus of countless scurrying steps echoes down a northeastern tunnel, where green-tinged pale phosphorescence relieves the shadows.  A pungent scent like crude oil saturates the air.
title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
34738.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: White bleeding-heart and crimson mournbloom flourish in beds at the base of an alabaster wall framing the garden of a temple to the north.  The temple's gates are adorned with figures in brass, their clinging attire brazenly highlighting lissome builds.  Beyond, the temple is built from blocks of white marble shot through with crimson and rose veins.  A circular fountain of the same material stands at the middle of the road, supporting a statue of a preternaturally beautiful man with outstretched arms.
title: [Sablecross, Vesper Crescent]
34739.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: White and red roses crawl the gilded fence of the garden, the pristine buds and blossoms filling the air with a gently sweet perfume.  No less lovely are the abundance of mournblooms and bleeding heart that prosper in beds lined with pale chunks of stone, jealously guarded by stinging nettle.  The flora bounds a trail of crushed alabaster running from gates of white imflass to a pale marble temple erected far from the street.
title: [The Garden, Yard]
34740.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lush, pale silks cascade in luxuriant spills from the high domed roof of the antechamber, each graced with a scant spiral of crimson petals.  The floor of red-veined white marble tiles radiates outward from a dagger-pierced heart formed from tesserae at the room's center.  Drifting in the breeze beckoning through the entrance, the silks reveal glimpses of silvered manacles hanging from arched recesses in the walls.
title: [The Garden, Antechamber]
34741.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Daylight filters in through brightly colored windows of stained glass, awakening rosy hues in the marble statues lining the walk.  One sculpture, that of a beautiful man clad in sheer robes, is given pride of place atop a tall pedestal, but all of the statuary depicts beings of preternatural beauty.  Most are twined in chains about the wrists and neck.
title: [The Garden, Statuary]
34742.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Pristine red and white roses sweeten the small alcove with their velvety perfume, notes of honey and spice lingering on the air.  Pedestals draped in white velvet hold a variety of relics.  One supports a coiled whip, another a blackened humerus fused with shards of blue-black razern, and a third a crystal bottle full of ruddy sand.  Each has a placard beneath it.  The eastern wall boasts a teardrop-shaped mirror of silver, the decoration's simplicity in peculiar counterpoint to the chamber's elegant decor.
title: [The Garden, Rose Chamber]
34743.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The roof of the temple cuts away to reveal open sky over a neatly manicured garden.  Pathways of crushed alabaster wind between planters ablossom with crimson and white roses.  The garden's real bounty occupies large mistwood stakes driven into the ground.  Many hoist lithe figures in clinging silk shifts hanging from manacles of white imflass, their moans and cries an incessant drone in the air.  A carved alabaster archway leads into a small sanctuary at the garden's edge.
title: [The Garden, Living Harvest]
34744.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Brambles of vivid green paint stretch and coil along the walls of the small sanctuary, unfurling from a slender man limned in pale pigments.  The silk-swathed figure stands possessively behind an ornate altar of carved ivory fashioned in the shapes of acrobatic bodies wreathed in garlands of rose and sweetbriar.  Rose and mournbloom incense intertwine in a dreamy haze, perfuming the air, which is occasionally punctuated by screams from the garden outside a carved alabaster archway.
title: [The Garden, Sanctum of Thorns]
34745.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Banners of stygian velvet trimmed with golden brocade are emblazoned with prowling jackals.  They twist in a cold breeze with no apparent source that gusts through the hallway in frigid surges.  Standing solitary atop a low circular platform at the chamber's center is a pair of doors hewn from black stone that reflects no light.  Shards of amber dreamstone gleam from the frame as if lit from within.
title: [Temple of Screams, Night's Door]
34746.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The walls of the hallway are a lightless black, matte in a way that reflects no ambient radiance.  Despite their tenebrous shade, hints of color swirl through the darkness, taking on strange forms.  The images stretch along the walkway, creeping toward faltering radiance in the west, where stairs of gold-shot marble ascend to a semicircular dais.
title: [Temple of Screams, Nightmares]
34747.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Eyes of amber glint sharply from the mask of an ebony jackal statue, the shadow of which looms over an altar of obsidian.  The stone is roughly hewn and twisted, but it supports a chunk of pure dreamstone shaped into a crude orb.  Torches flicker in sconces along the walls, throwing back the darkness, but casting long and sinister shadows.
title: [Temple of Screams, Shadow Altar]
34748.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crude friezes are painted along the walls of dark blue stone.  Under the feeble light of nautical lanterns hung from the ceiling by swaying chains, the paintings fluoresce an unsettling, vivid indigo, revealing the writhing bodies of countless eels.  Underfoot, the floor is transparent, offering glimpses of darting fish as they glint and gleam in the uncertain light.  Stairs of silver-shot marble descend into the depths below.
title: [The Deep Shrine, Delve]
34749.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Silver-shot indigo steps descend to a dome-shaped chamber lit only by nautical lanterns.  Their briny smell suggests that their feeble flames are fed by whale oil.  Walls of thick glass hold back the press of dark water in every direction, the lanterns' light offering only the faintest glimpses of black shapes swimming and squirming through the water.  At the center of the chamber sits an altar cut from a single great chunk of seaglass.  Over it looms a statue of an eel devouring its own tail.
title: [The Deep Shrine, Altar]
34750.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lurid tapestries of scarlet and milky green silk flutter overhead, making the humanoid forms they depict undulate and writhe.  Cushions in the same colors are strewn in uneven rows across the smooth marble floor, proceeding toward northbound steps clad in runners of sumptuous velvet.  In jade-framed niches along the walls, friezes depict bodies embracing and clambering atop one another while an exquisite woman shrouded in green smoke looks on.
title: [Temple of Flesh, Nave]
34751.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vibrant friezes beckon in jeweled tones from the domed ceiling and jade-framed walls of the sanctuary.  At its center, steps radiate downward from a circular altar of red and green jade with supports carved in the shapes of feminine figures.   Censers hang from the ceiling on spiraling chains of bronze, swaying as they release sweetly scented smoke in lazy, cloying clouds.
title: [Temple of Flesh, Altar]
34752.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Sandstone pillars stretching from floor to ceiling take the shapes of leaping cats, their agile forms carved in motion.  They support a multifaceted crystal dome that spills sunlight into the chamber.  The brilliant illumination cascades down the powerfully muscled back of a slumbering lion facing the entryway.  The beast looks as if it might rock with an intake of breath at any instant, but it is merely a statue, similar in make to the felines of ebony and bloodwood set into niches along the walls.
title: [The Hunter's Close, Menagerie]
34753.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Reliefs spread along the walls of the chamber, depicting felines lazing, hunting, and at play.  Their ancient pigments have been faded by the grinding passage of time, but the carvings themselves have been well preserved.  A mosaic depicting interlocking felines, one ebon and one crimson, spreads from the base of a low sandstone pedestal.  Atop it stands a wide brass bowl caked in dried blood.
title: [The Hunter's Close, Offerings]
34754.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Glinting shards of sunlight fall onto the sandstone slab floor of the chamber, revealing faint carvings in the stone shaped like paw prints.  They wind between the forms of cats carved from bloodwood and ebony that range in size from the meanest housecat to powerful lions.  All look toward a broad altar ablaze with beeswax candles, their honeyed scent mingling with cinnamon and sandalwood incense.  The wall behind the altar is limned with the image of a man with a cruel smile and lambent golden eyes.
title: [The Hunter's Close, Altar]
34755.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Far above, a ceiling of stained glass looms, painting the sunlight in fiery colors as it filters through to fall in sharp-edged shards to the charcoal grey marble floor of the narthex.  Sumptuous curtains of flame-hued velvet frame the walls, save for the northernmost, which boasts a hammered steel arch leading to a grand staircase.  Before it stands a massive throne of steel graced with a froth of gilt and inlaid rubies, empty but for a dark metal crown worked to resemble tongues of leaping flame.
title: [The Fane of Steel, Narthex]
34756.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Roaring flames of gilt frame the steel of a hammered arch leading to the temple's narthex.  Mirroring stairways of grey marble lushly clad in runners of flame-hued velvet curve away from one another as they ascend to the upper reaches of the fane.  Along the southern wall, an elaborate mural depicts a preternaturally beautiful woman with dark skin and sharp grey eyes standing beneath the wings of an immense draconic figure.
title: [The Fane of Steel, Grand Stair]
34757.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long hallway proceeds from a pair of spiraling staircases toward steps leading to a raised dais in the north.  Luxuriant curtains of flame-hued velvet soften the severity of the gallery's high marble walls, which display priceless paintings framed in gilded steel.  Sunlight is transfigured into fireglow by the brightly colored shards of the stained glass ceiling, which continues out over the narthex far below.  The masterwork depicts a sinuous black draconic figure breathing a wall of raging fire.
title: [The Fane of Steel, Gallery]
34758.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The outline of a crown in steel and gilt has been inlaid into the marble of the far wall, where it glints menacingly in the radiance pouring through the stained glass ceiling.  Torrents of flame blaze from three great stone hearths set into the walls, their infernal breath filling the air with oppressive, stinging heat.  Atop an altar of grey steel etched with golden tongues of fire, a charcoal grey prayerbook lies open, its pages edged in brilliant gilt.
title: [The Fane of Steel, Altar]
34759.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Framed by arched walls filled with friezes depicting sacrificial rites and scenes of carnage, the stretch of hallway is broken by a black stone fountain atop a series of circular steps.  The spigot, fashioned of mauve eahnor in the shape of a two-headed serpent, spits a constant flow of thick carmine fluid into the bowl below.  Candlelight, stained startling crimson, flickers through a black bloodwood door in the northern wall.
title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Fountain]
34760.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gutters and channels in the floor form a gruesome arcane pattern.  They radiate outward from a flat black stone that is several feet high and roughly the length of a tall humanoid.  Overhead, the zealous countenance of a faintly scaled elf stares down, his crimson eyes burning with merciless fascination.  Red and violet asps intertwine along the borders of the ceiling painting.
title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Stone]
34761.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A two-headed serpent of violet and scarlet stone strains across the walls of the sanctum, a blood-drenched figure with scales on his face caught amidst its powerful coils.  Before him stands an altar carved from a single piece of bloodstone.  Fountains to either side spray blood into basins of marble, the crimson flow stark against the pale stone.  Candles burning in huddled groups around the chamber's perimeter light the room, but cannot excise the scent of copper from the air.
title: [The Crimson Ziggurat, Altar]
34762.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mirroring mosaics flank the hallway, the eastern one, which depicts a cracked white skull on a field of black, giving way to an arch leading into a shadowed chamber.  Its mate portrays a hand wielding a glinting steel dagger and is made from glass tesserae dyed in a variety of hues.  Runners of black wool with an ivory fringe proceed north toward an altar.
title: [The Slayer's Den, Approach]
34763.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A hawk of ebony is perched atop a stand of the same material, its talons clutching the upper roll of a scroll scrawled with a list of names.  Other such scrolls are furled and sealed with wax, housed in niches honeycombing the walls.  The low ceiling is inlaid with a skull made from polished ivory, pristine save for a crack digging into its left temple.
title: [The Slayer's Den, Contract Hall]
34764.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A fresco stretches across the northern wall of the temple's sanctuary.  Staring gravely down upon a raised dais occupied by a bone-inlaid ebony altar, a smallish man with emotionless blue eyes and an agile build is framed by a field of shadows.  The legs of the altar sprout from a pile of skulls heaped at its base.  The bones are of a wide variety of sizes and shapes, unalike but united in death.
title: [The Slayer's Den, Dark Sanctum]
34765.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Whorling nets of shadowed silk funnel down into fathomless crevices and crannies in the wall of the cave, while others hang from the ceiling like tattered parodies of curtains.  Green-tinged luminescence burning in the hearts of the sticky strands serves as an uncertain and treacherous cynosure through the stygian passage.  Toward the end, the spidersilk grows dense and more radiant before culminating in a wall of webs.
title: [Shadowsilk Passage, Dark Path]
34766.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Swarms of tiny spiders with glistening incarnadine bodies scurry through the phosphorescent darkness.  The crude oil smell of thousands upon thousands of tiny spiders threads through the air, muting other scents just as the thick and faintly glowing webbing dangling from the ceiling muffles sounds.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Widow's Trap]
34767.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dense wall of inky webs occludes a sprawling mural limned across the face of the southwestern wall, but glints of sanguine enamel wink through like rubies.  Coruscating in the light of a dancing torch, the black bodies of multitudinous spiders skitter along the webs, engaged in tireless industry.  The sconce holding the torch is wrought of black alum and studded with red cabochon gems.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Webwall]
34768.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Driven by torchlight from the southeast, shadows race over the huge back of a black stone spider statue rearing back to strike.  They linger on a huge red crystal hourglass breaching the smooth plane of the stone creature's back.  The statue's shadow looms over the sullen glow of rubies inlaid into a dais of black ora.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Sacrifice]
34769.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Torchlight flickers to the southwest, but the span of the eastern chamber labors under the heavy press of shadow.  Rearing up out of a nest of blackness darker than pitch, an immense spider statue hewn from oily black stone dominates the eastern quadrant of the shrine.  Its carapace is swollen and huge, and a pair of serrated razern fangs curve down from its jaw, each tinged a darker hue by bile-green fluid staining its surface.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Venom]
34770.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Luminous garnets studding the face of the northern wall limn the uneven stones of the walkway a dark carmine hue.  They cluster most tightly about the bulk of an oily black alcove enameled with crisscrossing webs, casting their inner fire over the pages of a slender black tome atop a silver pedestal.  Tattered cobwebs drip down from the ceiling in glittering curtains, forming jagged patterns at the corners of of the shrine.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Alcove]
34771.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A mammoth statue reigns over a raised metal dais rimmed with uncut rubies and garnets, representing a hideous fusion of woman and spider.  Tiny strands of spidersilk sway around her form, each thread lit from within by ghost-pale green phosphorescence.
title: [Shadowsilk Shrine, Supplication]
34772.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two immense fangs of stone bear down upon a wide aperture in the southern wall, permitting a dizzying view of the land below, from the green-tufted tops of weeping willows and cypresses to the bustling streets of the village beyond.  Only the spire at the center of town stands taller.  Despite the wind swirling through the opening, the air holds intense, prickling heat, its obvious source the emerald firelight crackling from archways to the northwest and northeast.
title: [The Fang, Overlook]
34773.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Hungry fires burn green in alcoves along the walls, making the air behind a stygian stone altar warp and shimmer with their infernal heat.  Their radiance dances off of the facets of viridian soulstone shards set into the black walls in an undulating pattern.  It bathes the curves of the altar, which is carved into the shape of a large, coiled snake.  The western wall yields to a huge circular window made up of crystal panes.  Cruel daylight streams through the glass, casting long, dark shadows through the chamber.
title: [The Fang, Altar of Souls]
34774.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Intense flames roar from alcoves along the walls, their dancing radiance scattering off of viridian soulstone shards that weave along the walls like a sidewinder's path.  Standing before the inferno is a pure white altar of stone that takes the form of a scaled man with no mouth.  Along the eastern wall, a circular glass window allows daylight to join with the fiery radiance, and the altar shines almost blindingly with the reflected glow.
title: [The Fang, Altar of Truths]
34775.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Ancient petrified oak bookshelves proceed into the distance in every direction, neatly stacked with countless books.  The acrid scent of preservatives mingles with the dusty tang of old parchment in the dry, cool air.  Gold-trimmed charcoal grey carpeting runs down a wide central aisle toward a raised desk topped by a curve of marble.  Atop it are stacks of recently returned tomes and a huge ledger holding enough yellowed pages to be an epic in its own right.
title: [The Archive, Bibliotheca]
34776.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Silver leaf and gilt illuminate artwork on the wall above a raised dais mounted by a set of steps.  The figure, a man with an unkempt beard in rough homespun robes, is bent with the weight of age and knowledge.  His aged eyes balefully look down upon a carved stone altar draped in offerings of lavender, bay laurel, and Vornavian hemlock.  Atop the altar stands a slender grey obelisk, simple in form but intricate in craftsmanship.
title: [The Archive, Dais]
34777.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A quiet chamber is separated from the rest of the library by a fireleaf arch carved to resemble leaping flames.  At the zenith of the woodwork is a slit-pupiled eye.  Glass cases framed in veil iron dot the perimeter of the richly appointed recess, each containing a book on a bed of dusky golden velvet.  One pale book is bound in kroderine chains, while a black tome nearby has wards drawn in chalk beneath it.
title: [The Archive, Reserve Collection]
34778.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Black trees snatch at the cold sky along the wall of the small estate.  Dead or dying, the plants of the yard are mostly buried by snowfall, though the space before a small shrine in the shadow of the trees is mostly clear.  The manse has fallen into disrepair and not a hint of light beckons from cracked windows hidden behind heavy boards meant to keep out intruders.  Along its facade, a trio of slashes are gouged out of the masonry as if an animal's claws have sliced through the stone.
title: [Forsaken Manse, Yard]
34779.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The air is thick with the pungent stink of tanning agents and the sickly sweet odor of animal carcasses.  Windows opened to let the malodorous melange escape share the stony walls with fine furs and fangs from a wide assortment of beasts.  Behind the counter a swarthy furrier works her trade, aided by tanning racks and vats of murky yellow fluid.  A massive skull with curled horns and a long jaw hangs over the partition.
title: [Skins and Grins, Salesroom]
35238.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Baskets hang from the ceiling over numerous bins filled with bolts of dusty cloth, empty flour sacks, and broken jars.  The windows are thick with accumulated soot and dirt, the letters painted on the glass announcing a sale on tea leaves faded and peeling.  Along the back wall, a tall counter with stools at one end separates the front room from some small living quarters outfitted with a narrow cot and a metal footlocker.
title: [Reim Settlement, General Store]
23484.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Suits of armor line the walls around the shop, each with a magnificent winged helm in the shape of a predatory bird.  A wrought iron rack displays aventails, greaves, and gauntlets that are tarnished and dull.  A woodstove sits to one side of a narrow staircase along the far wall, leading up to a loft with sparse furnishings.
title: [Reim Settlement, Armor Shop]
23650.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large makeshift structure pieced together with wooden planks and stretched canvas squares presides over the rocky outcropping closest to the edge.  Several pathways lined with gravel and salt spiral outward from the makeshift structure.  Tents of assorted colors and sizes are positioned evenly apart in several rows along the cliff face.
meta: mapname:Quests - Reim Fortress and Base Camp
title: [Reim Base Camp]
24842.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A narrow inlet of water trickles into a circular pond that lays eerily still, a watery vortex spinning in its center.  Glowing veins of assorted minerals, rich with ore deposits, line the walls from floor to ceiling.  Pooling on the floor of the cavern is a thick white mist that obscures the surroundings.
meta: mapname:Icemule Trace - The Settlement of Reim
title: [A Tunneled Approach]
24863.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cavern slopes upward, the enveloping walls covered with spiral-like grooves with intricately carved gems imbedded in each channel.  A steady glow of blue light ebbs and flows further up in the tunnel.
title: [A Tunneled Approach]
24864.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The carved spirals of the ceiling, walls, and floor tighten inward as the cavern narrows in its ascent.  Assorted stalactites hang precariously from the ceiling with an exact mirrored stalagmite directly beneath each.  Floating between the pairings of stalagmites and stalactites are small ethereal balls of light.
title: [A Tunneled Approach]
24870.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tunnel opens up into an awe-inspiring gallery.  Stretching as far as the eye can see is a massive crater with a narrow path running along the edge.  The crater is filled with a dense bank of fog, its depth unknown.  In the distance, a bunch of tangled iron chains dangle.
title: [A Cavernous Approach]
24875.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path ends on a small platform, where hanging just out of reach over the crater are some massive chains, swaying back and forth.  The ceiling of the cavern is carved out in a circular shape surrounding the chains as they continue skyward.  Dense banks of clouds cling to the opening in the ceiling, blotting out any light from above.
title: [A Cavernous Approach]
24876.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Massive chains stretch up into the sky at a steep angle, and disappear from sight in some thick, slowly moving clouds.  A bird trills loudly as it darts through the middle of one of the links before diving straight down towards the ground far below.  The air feels thin as the chains subtly sway like a pendulum before coming to a halt.

The night sky is brilliantly lit with an innumerable number of bright stars, and a pair of padded wooden chairs are situated to allow both comfortable relaxation and easy access to a small rhimar chest strategically placed between them.

A sturdy desk sits in the middle of the room, its surface covered with trinkets and baubles, and a large cabinet stands against one wall.  Interspersed around the walls are various paintings, each one rather abstract and seeming to be more focused on colors than shapes.  A small window provides enough light to see by, and a small fireplace is nestled against one wall in case more light or heat is required.
title: [Sunset Cabin, Workshop]
31356.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

The faint scents of cinnamon and sugar hang in the air, remnants of previous culinary experiences.

Frost-swept clusters of ruffled clover blot the niveous surroundings with striking dollops of greenery.  A sturdy, nicely appointed cypress log cabin with a gabled roof is plunked among some blue-blushed winter roses and encircled by unruly crallisberry hedges.

Hunting-themed oil paintings in gold frames adorn the polished cypress walls with a rustic flair, yielding to a fauna-carved rowan arch on the eastern wall. description: A cold, grey mist swirls around you, making it difficult to gain any sense of what is here.  Through the haze a huge, gnarled hand stretches upward reaching grimly for something past your vision.  As you move closer, it turns out to be only a dead tree, the bent and gnarled limbs twisting toward a blood eagle hovering just out of reach.
title: [The Rift]
2579.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sound of hoofbeats approaches rapidly.  When you whirl around, a white horse emerges from the surrounding mist with a black robed figure on its back.  As the horse gallops by, the sound of a blade cutting the air fills your ears, and a burst of wind brushes your neck.  The horseman quickly fades into the mist before you, a scythe the last thing you see as it disappears.
title: [The Rift]
2580.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your wandering brings you to a small clearing.  The ground is dry and parched, and there are large lines scratched into the surface and coated in a red, sticky substance.  Following the lines a moment, you realize they make a rune covered circle, and that you are standing in the center of it.  A cold wind whips around you at that point, and you hear howls in the distance.
title: [The Rift]
2581.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small wooden sign sits before you, ancient writing scrawled across the surface.  Just behind it, a huge pit extends deep into the ground.  An unusual silence hangs heavily over the area, broken occasionally by a metallic squeak from the pit.  Looking inside, you see thousands of small, grooved metal rods imbedded in the walls rotating slowly.  The further down the pit extends, the more narrow it becomes until you can see no more.
title: [The Rift]
2582.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A jagged chasm opens up nearly beneath your feet.  Before you can step into it, a sharp barking sound startles you, catching your attention and bringing you to a halt.  Looking down, you see a small skeletal dog at your feet.  He dances nimbly before you, halting your forward progress into the pit.  Blinking, you look again, and both the dog and the chasm are gone.

2583.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mist swirls and flows around a small monument here.  A man lies on the ground face down, quite dead.  There are ten longswords protruding from his back, from the tip of the neck to the back of the knees.  Small rivulets of blood have dried as they left the body, forming an unusual pattern in the dirt.
title: [The Rift]
2584.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chains creak and strain under the load they are holding in the center of this stone-walled room.  Eight rolaren chains reach up, entangle, and reach down to the ground on the opposite side of the large shadowy mass hovering just above the floor.  It shifts and moves, as if alive and seeking an escape from the bindings.  The chains glow slightly in the dim light, throwing unusual shadows on the walls while keeping the mass from growing too much.

The stains are a dark red or brown, giving the appearance the building has been sweating blood.  A weathered metal sign hangs just above the entryway, creaking in the non-existent breeze.

2586.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A volcano erupts in the distance, spewing molten lava and ash all over.  The lava flies high into the air, carrying with it chunks of mountain and clouds of ash.  In the large crater the eruption created, you see figures moving about in the lava itself.  They splash in it and throw it on each other, howling and laughing.  Above the mountain, dark red birds of some kind dodge flying lava and debris, screeching in contentment.

Obvious paths: east, southwest, west, northwest

2587.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: In the distance walks a tall man.  His robe is grey and tattered, but the frame beneath it remains strong.  Above his head floats the symbol of infinity, black and tarnished as the path he walks.  No matter how rapidly you proceed towards him, you cannot seem to catch him, although he moves no faster than a saunter.
title: [The Rift]
2588.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense structure stands before you, built of now-ruined white marble columns.  In the center sits a crumbling throne, flanked by two pillars.  Each may have had a symbol at one time, but ages of decay have erased any decoration.  Upon the throne sits a rotting zombie.  Her sightless eyes stare out into nothingness, and her feet have fallen into the bowl of the stone crescent at the base of her seat.
title: [The Rift]
2589.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Screaming wind tears through this area, filling the air with a dreadful howling.  Just ahead a cavern looms, offering a bit of solace from the biting wind.  As you move closer to the safehaven, you see that the cavern is actually the open mouth of a massive, long-fallen statue.
title: [The Rift]
2590.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge fountain of blood erupts from the ground here, gushing hundreds of feet into the air and raining back down hard.  At its apex, the thick fluid holds the pattern of a pair of eyes, watching your movements as you pass through.  The eyes hold your own a moment, and a wave of nausea passes over you. When it fades, they have wavered and fallen with their medium.
paths: Obvious exits: northeast, east, south, west, northwest
Obvious paths: northeast, east, south, west, northwest
title: [The Rift]
2591.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Before you stands a large green house, with smoke billowing out the chimney and the windows broken out.  In front of the worn domicile, an older man and woman lie dead, chests slashed open and eyes staring sightlessly into the sky.  Above them stands a young man, resembling them.  He regards you in a cold, calculating manner, hand clenching and unclenching a bloody blade.
title: [The Rift]
2592.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dilapidated yellow house sits just to the west of you.  It is surrounded by a small, white fence, and a pebble walkway flanked by withered flowers leads to the old domicile.  Sitting in the windowsill is a large, orange cat that looks at you with spectral eyes.  Just behind it is a small, ghostly girl with her hair in pigtails, stroking the fur of her long departed friend. She looks at you with large eyes, seeming to see through you into some other realm altogether.
title: [The Rift]
2593.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A graveyard lies before you.  Unlike a normal graveyard, however, the things that now rest here never were alive.  Hundreds of broken statues litter the field, some gazing sightlessly off into the distance, others reaching with stone hands up to whatever salvation waits for them beyond.  The forgotten relics' final resting place gives an eerie air to the surrounding areas, as if you could share their unfortunate fate.
title: [The Rift]
2594.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long field stretches before you, covered by dark clouds.  The field is lined with rows and rows of long metal poles, each of which is situated near a stone door.  While you look over the field, lightning flashes down from the clouds and strikes one of the poles.  As the pole absorbs the burst of energy, the door nearest to it slowly swings open, revealing a black stone passage behind.  The door stays open a few seconds, then slowly swings closed again.
title: [The Rift]
2595.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The granite wall before you is covered in a huge mural of gouges and scratches.  The pattern spreads from the bottom of the wall upwards, branching much like a tree into various parts.  Studying the damage a bit more, you realize it was all very carefully planned, although why isn't immediately apparent.

description: Climbing a small hill, you now look over a long valley filled with warriors.  A huge giantman in plate-mail stands at the front of the vanguard, holding a battle axe in each hand.  His skin is rotted and mildewed, and the hollow eye sockets drop bits of goo and small bugs.  The entire host of undead soldiers shifts anxiously behind him, as if waiting for a command from their chieftain.

description: A throne sits in the middle of an open field.  Dead and dried flower bushes grow over it, lacing thistles through the hair and bones of the half-rotted woman sitting within it.  Enough flesh remains to identify her gender, but the rest is gone, devoured by the plants and elements.
title: [The Rift]
2598.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despair and desolation hang heavy in the air over the small plain before you.  Off in the distance, near the coast, what was once a small city lies smouldering in ruins.  The thick, black smoke from the razed hamlet lies heavy near the building tops, as if the weight of the carnage held it fast.  A huge stack of bodies is piled near the western gate, some of which almost look familiar.
title: [The Rift]
2599.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A battered wooden gate rests against the pitted stone walls surrounding a small city.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Members of an invading force, beasts of burden, and captives travel the broken street leading into the remnants of town.  A bestial military squad drills on the rocky parade ground just inside the gate.  Fog obscures them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend in with the din of the prisoners at the gate.
title: [The Rift]
2600.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep in the forest rests what was once a small shrine carefully carved of the butchered haon wood that surrounds you.  Screams and the violent falling of trees fill the air with a strong sense of destruction.  From somewhere nearby, the angry sound of a river rapids completes the unusual symphony.  Little else alters the disquiet save for an occasional muted plea drifting in on the breeze.
title: [The Rift]
2601.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Four banks of mist flow together, a distant scene forming within them.  A bustling town comes together in the square.  Halflings dressed in old style clothing stand about, some yelling angrily, others slain as they lay on their cloaks on the ground.  One ancient dark elf leans against the base of the large frozen statue of a pack animal, smirking arrogantly.
title: [The Rift]
2602.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Crimson veins run through the black marble of the walls of the throne room.  The streaks seem to pulse, as if it they were not streamers of red lacing the black stone, but actual arteries carrying blood through the rock.  Upon a massive, corroded silver throne sits a man whose eyes are pools of black essence.  They seem to pull the light into themselves, allowing no spark of brightness or hope to escape.  "Slaughter them," he is saying.  "Kill them all and leave their corpses for the maggots."
title: [The Rift]
2603.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fog you wander through parts to reveal thousands of stairways surrounding you.  Sets of stairs lead to unknown destinations around you, up and down, horizontal and vertical.  The bizarre monument fills your vision as far as you can see, none of the stairs really appear to be going anywhere except to other stairs.

description: The path is flanked on both sides by black water, thick and sluggish with salt.  A tiny boat is beached on the shore, but the waves and tide still reach beyond its bow.  As the waves break around it, the dinghy rocks slightly and shifts in the swirling, bubbling sand.  Two people relax in the boat, a young man and woman, talking and laughing. While they sit, however, the boat lurches sickeningly and begins to take on water.  They look sad, and stare into each other's eyes as the sea claims them.
title: [The Rift]
2605.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small, faded festival tent has been set up in a patch of grass here.  The tent covers several long tables with cakes and pastries arranged on them.  Behind and to the sides of the tent, couples dance together, completely oblivious to your presence.  The crowd of revelers moves stiffly, like puppets under the hand of a new master.  Slowly they all turn and look at you, lifeless eyes pleading for release from this grim masquerade, then return to their partners in resignation as the dance continues.
title: [The Rift]
2606.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The horizon is scrutinized by cautious sentries as you arrive at the wide gateway guarding the land route to a wildland outpost.  The frantic preparations of the citizens to the south are a far cry from the deceptive calm of the mists around you.  Two charred and beaten towers survey the countryside and hold silent vigil over the town, flanking the road to the east and west.
title: [The Rift]
2607.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The immense cathedral is dark.  The candles have melted to their holders in deformed blobs, and the torches have long since burned out.  At the pulpit kneels a high man of the church.  He faces the splintered and destroyed pews, the desecrated place of worship, and weeps brokenheartedly, staff on the ground before him.
title: [The Rift]
2608.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circular marble pillar sits in the middle of a room with thick grey tapestries for walls.  Above this pillar floats a large skull that appears to be serpentine or lizardlike in nature, slowly rotating in a sphere of blue energy.  The skull rotates, morphing into an elven one, then gently spinning again and changing into a human one, then a krolvin skull, then a giant one, and finally back to the serpent one.
title: [The Rift]
2609.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge three-masted ship floats in midair here just above the ground, sails rippling gently in the slight breeze.  Deck hands from on board make noise as they move about, adjusting cargo and preparing for voyage.  From the crow's nest high above, you can see the ship's falconer directing large hunting hawks through aerial warm-up exercises.
title: [The Rift]
2610.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A giant hangs on an elaborate set of poles and straps here.  Two thick poles set crossing each other are framed by two vertical and two horizontal ones.  Violet eyes shrouded in shadow float near the giant's head, watching the expressions that pass there with great interest.  A pair of winged snakes hover near the giant, flying idly about and occasionally striking him.
title: [The Rift]
2611.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fog parts revealing a pitch black area.  Blackness wraps around you like a velvety greatcloak as you step tenatively into the dark.  A slithering hiss surrounds you, circling you several times before retreating into the heavy silence and darkness.
title: [The Rift]
2612.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sky boils with dark black clouds.  Lightning flashes across the sky,  and wind howls across the barren landscape.  Within the clouds, you can see the form of a man, standing in the center of the tempest.  He stares down upon the ruins of an old shrine, where a man and woman huddle in a corner, cleaving to each other for comfort.
title: [The Rift]
2613.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge cliff looms before you, stretching far into the sky above.  About halfway up the face an immense red-skinned man rides the air currents, flapping his leathery wings to hold his position.  On the wall next to him are crude columns made of bodies impaled to the wall, each column topped off with a different type of weapon resting on rough hooks.
title: [The Rift]
2614.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Rows of cages line the walkways, bars rusting away in the damp air.  Within each is a deformed and horrible creature, stalking behind the metal grills.  The cage in the center contains a three-headed lion, frothing and drooling in snarling rage.  A woman stands within it, desperately attempting to hold the maws of the lion's heads shut, but her chances look slim at best.
title: [The Rift]
2615.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Even for a giant, the body laying on the ground before you is huge.  It lies face down, a pool of blood widening slowly around it.  The giant's outstretched arms clutch a battle axe in one hand and a thin veil iron circlet in the other, as if to keep hold of them even in death.  Fortunately, the pack of wild dogs ripping at the body doesn't seem to care about them, only about their dinner.

title: [The Rift]
2616.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large snow-filled valley with rough sloping sides opens up before you.  On the ridge tops from one end to the other stand two main groups of creatures.  The north ridge holds huge clans of ice trolls standing ready with large slabs of ice, while on the south ridge groups of frost giants mutter at each other, holding equally large slabs.  In the center of the valley a lone storm giant stands, arms up to signal the racers.
title: [The Rift]
2617.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stout wooden wall impedes your progress forward.  In the center of the wall, on a large yellowed parchment, is a poster.  The poster is a side view of a man laying in a coffin or box of some kind.  Small arrows point to parts of the picture, and in an unknown language describe some of the things in it.  A second, older poster next to the first has the picture of an old, one-eyed dark elf with the number "12000" below it.
tags: peer east =~ /^Obvious (?:paths|exits): northeast, east, west, northwest/
title: [The Rift]
2618.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A chariot sits in the center of the path.  The horses pulling it run hard, sweat and foam flying off their bodies as their hooves churn.  The driver whips them on, leaning into the wind.  He occasionally glances over his shoulder, as if watching for some threat from behind.  Despite the running horses or windblown driver, the chariot is going nowhere, simply spinning its wheels in the middle of the road.
title: [The Rift]
2620.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense tapestry hangs here in midair.  Thin magical threads create the shimmering cloth, almost seeming to move and adjust themselves as they hang.  Several long, shadowy outlines hover near the tapestry, attending to the minor knots and slips.  At this position you are too close to see the entire work of art, but it does seem somehow familiar.
title: [The Rift]
2621.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gargoyles hover above a huge, dark pit in the ground a small distance off.  They occasionally swoop into it, then shoot out on a burst of air, screaming with excitement.  All manner of bugs and small creatures swarm around the lip of the hole, the thick ring oozing slowly outward from its point of origin.
title: [The Rift]
2622.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long line of robed monks walks solemnly, fading off into the distance.  They seem to be traveling toward the largest mountain of a set which runs across the distant horizon.  Two bursts of flame shoot up from an opening in the mountain occasionally, illuminating a skull-shaped castle and a line of supplicants several miles long moving towards it.
title: [The Rift]
2623.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense statue stands before you towering hundreds of feet high, giving you an excellent view of its ankle.  The statue has a large, muscular frame, and is resting his hands on the pommel of a two-handed sword.  As you look up the statue's length, you realize it has one fatal flaw - it's headless.
title: [The Rift]
2624.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sound of blades violently whipping through the air fills your ears.  As you move a bit further, the fog churning around you parts, and you see an unusual type of cell before you.  Scimitars whirl through the air of their own volition, holding a roughly circular pattern.  Inside the cell sits an old Krolvin warlord missing a few chunks of flesh, probably from attempted escapes.
title: [The Rift]
2625.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A white pillar stretches up into the vast reaches of the dark sky here.  On either side of the enruned pillar are two full length mirrors, slowly rotating horizontally.  One mirror is lined with a white haon frame, the other with a black thanot one.  A small pool of blood has coagulated around the white pillar, and while something appears to be written in it, the letters are too messy to make out.
title: [The Rift]
2626.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A portrait rests against an immense boulder here.  The boulder seems to have a vaguely familiar shape, but exactly what is too difficult to place.  Leaning against the base of the boulder is a modwir-framed picture, depicting an incredibly strong man wrestling with a heavy burden.  The rock he holds appears to grow heavier, and he looks tired and pained by the weight of it.  At the base of the painting before you are two footprints imbedded deeply into the ground.
title: [The Rift]
