title: [The Rift]
12093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: All the world is white, covered in a snow so pure and crystalline that any light that strikes it is reflected back one-thousandfold.  The reflections are then reflected back, magnifying and growing in intensity until anyone unfortunate enough to wander in could possibly be struck blind.  Unfortunately, the sun is shining.
title: [The Rift]
12094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sound of hoofbeats approaches rapidly.  When you whirl around, a white horse emerges from the surrounding mist with a black robed figure on its back.  As the horse gallops by, the sound of a blade cutting the air fills your ears, and a burst of wind brushes your neck.  The horseman quickly fades into the mist before you, a scythe the last thing you see as it disappears.
title: [The Rift]
12174.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Your wandering brings you to a small clearing.  The ground is dry and parched, and there are large lines scratched into the surface and coated in a red, sticky substance.  Following the lines a moment, you realize they make a rune covered circle, and that you are standing in the center of it.  A cold wind whips around you at that point, and you hear howls in the distance.
title: [The Rift]
12175.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mist swirls and flows around a small monument here.  A man lies on the ground face down, quite dead.  There are ten longswords protruding from his back, from the tip of the neck to the back of the knees.  Small rivulets of blood have dried as they left the body, forming an unusual pattern in the dirt.
title: [The Rift]
12176.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Iridescent grey slime crawls over the walls, ceiling and floor, seeming to pulsate and almost breathe.  The air is heavy with moisture, and thick with the scents of jasmine and decay.  Your head swims with the conflicting scents, too sweet to inhale easily and too strong to clear from your lungs fully.
title: [The Rift]
12177.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small wooden sign sits before you, ancient writing scrawled across the surface.  Just behind it, a huge pit extends deep into the ground.  An unusual silence hangs heavily over the area, broken occasionally by a metallic squeak from the pit.  Looking inside, you see thousands of small, grooved metal rods imbedded in the walls rotating slowly.  The further down the pit extends, the more narrow it becomes until you can see no more.
title: [The Rift]
12178.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Chains creak and strain under the load they are holding in the center of this stone-walled room.  Eight rolaren chains reach up, entangle, and reach down to the ground on the opposite side of the large shadowy mass hovering just above the floor.  It shifts and moves, as if alive and seeking an escape from the bindings.  The chains glow slightly in the dim light, throwing unusual shadows on the walls while keeping the mass from growing too much.
title: [The Rift]
12179.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large, decrepit building stands on the top of a small hillock here.  Vines cover most of the building, avoiding only the dark stains running from the windows and roof.  The stains are a dark red or brown, giving the appearance the building has been sweating blood.  A weathered metal sign hangs just above the entryway, creaking in the non-existant breeze.
title: [The Rift]
12180.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A volcano erupts in the distance, spewing molten lava and ash all over.  The lava flies high into the air, carrying with it chunks of mountain and clouds of ash.  In the large crater the eruption created, you see figures moving about in the lava itself.  They splash in it and throw it on each other, howling and laughing.  Above the mountain, dark red birds of some kind dodge flying lava and debris, screeching in contentment.
title: [The Rift]
12181.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The battlefield is carpeted in bodies, littering the rolling hills and making it nearly impossible to walk.  Still the battle rages on, with men in bloodstained black plate mail battling against a struggling band of warriors in silver.  Waves of the dark knights ride over the field on immense ebon steeds, herding the argent-clad fighters into certain death.  A feeling of hopelessness permeates the area as those in shining armor forever fight a battle they cannot win.
title: [The Rift]
12182.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A dilapidated yellow house sits just to the west of you.  It is surrounded by a small, white fence, and a pebble walkway flanked by withered flowers leads to the old domicile.  Sitting in the windowsill is a large, orange cat that looks at you with spectral eyes.  Just behind it is a small, ghostly girl with her hair in pigtails, stroking the fur of her long departed friend. She looks at you with large eyes, seeming to see through you into some other realm altogether.
title: [The Rift]
12183.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Before you stands a large green house, with smoke billowing out the chimney and the windows broken out.  In front of the worn domicile, an older man and woman lie dead, chests slashed open and eyes staring sightlessly into the sky.  Above them stands a young man, resembling them.  He regards you in a cold, calculating manner, hand clenching and unclenching a bloody blade.
title: [The Rift]
12184.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge fountain of blood erupts from the ground here, gushing hundreds of feet into the air and raining back down hard.  At its apex, the thick fluid holds the pattern of a pair of eyes, watching your movements as you pass through.  The eyes hold your own a moment, and a wave of nausea passes over you. When it fades, they have wavered and fallen with their medium.
title: [The Rift]
12185.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Screaming wind tears through this area, filling the air with a dreadful howling.  Just ahead a cavern looms, offering a bit of solace from the biting wind.  As you move closer to the safehaven, you see that the cavern is actually the open mouth of a massive, long-fallen statue - the wind, an eternal scream.
title: [The Rift]
12186.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Above you the sky is black, dotted with shimmering stars.  The constellations hold no familiar patterns, creating a strangely eerie feeling of disorientation and aloneness.  Beneath your feet crumbles brown-red dirt the consistency of coarse flour.  Around you the air is thin, barely breathable and reeking strongly of sulphur.
title: [The Rift]
12187.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A graveyard lies before you.  Unlike a normal graveyard, however, the things that now rest here never were alive.  Hundreds of broken statues litter the field, some gazing sightlessly off into the distance, others reaching with stone hands up to whatever salvation waits for them beyond.  The forgotten relics' final resting place gives an eerie air to the surrounding areas, as if you could share their unfortunate fate.
title: [The Rift]
12188.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moans and shrieks of agony fill the large brown canvas tent.  Chirurgeons walk between the cots, attempting to tend the wounds of those who lay bleeding on the rude beds.  Suddenly, the flap of the tent is torn down, revealing a knight in bloody black armor.  He raises his gargantuan claidhmore...and the scene fades, leaving you standing on the crumbling red earth.
title: [The Rift]
12189.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Despair and desolation hang heavy in the air over the small plain before you.  Off in the distance, near the coast, what was once a small city lies smouldering in ruins.  The thick, black smoke from the razed hamlet lies heavy near the building tops, as if the weight of the carnage held it fast.  A huge stack of bodies is piled near the western gate, some of which almost look familiar.
title: [The Rift]
12190.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A small, faded festival tent has been set up in a patch of grass here.  The tent covers several long tables with cakes and pastries arranged on them.  Behind and to the sides of the tent, couples dance together, completely oblivious to your presence.  The crowd of revelers moves stiffly, like puppets under the hand of a new master.  Slowly they all turn and look at you, lifeless eyes pleading for release from this grim masquerade, then return to their partners in resignation as the dance continues.
title: [The Rift]
12191.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The path is flanked on both sides by black water, thick and sluggish with salt.  A tiny boat is beached on the shore, but the waves and tide still reach beyond its bow.  As the waves break around it, the dinghy rocks slightly and shifts in the swirling, bubbling sand.  Two people relax in the boat, a young man and woman, talking and laughing. While they sit, however, the boat lurches sickeningly and begins to take on water.  They look sad, and stare into each other's eyes as the sea claims them.
title: [The Rift]
12192.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fog you wander through parts to reveal thousands of stairways surrounding you.  Sets of stairs lead to unknown destinations around you, up and down, horizontal and vertical.  The bizarre monument fills your vision as far as you can see, none of the stairs really appear to be going anywhere except to other stairs.
title: [The Rift]
12193.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A set of stairs carved from the purest white marble spirals up...into nothingness.  No landing, no floor, simply a darkness so deep it seems to consume the light around it.  The stairs rest on a floor of dark black onyx, making the twisting white column the only spot of light in the area.
title: [The Rift]
12194.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Four banks of mist flow together, a distant scene forming within them.  A bustling town comes together in the square.  Halflings dressed in old style clothing stand about, some yelling angrily, others slain as they lay on their cloaks on the ground.  One ancient dark elf leans against the base of the large frozen statue of a pack animal, smirking arrogantly.
title: [The Rift]
12195.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Deep in the forest rests what was once a small shrine carefully carved of the butchered haon wood that surrounds you.  Screams and the violent falling of trees fill the air with a strong sense of destruction.  From somewhere nearby, the angry sound of a river rapids completes the unusual symphony.  Little else alters the disquiet save for an occasional muted plea drifting in on the breeze.
title: [The Rift]
12196.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A battered wooden gate rests against the pitted stone walls surrounding a small city.  Mail-clad guards with pikes and heavy crossbows pace back and forth atop the walls.  Members of an invading force, beasts of burden, and captives travel the broken street leading into the remnants of town.  A bestial military squad drills on the rocky parade ground just inside the gate.  Fog obscures them as they march to and fro, and the gruff barks of their sergeant blend in with the din of the prisoners at the gate.
title: [The Rift]
12197.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The horizon is scrutinized by cautious sentries as you arrive at the wide gateway guarding the land route to a wildland outpost.  The frantic preparations of the citizens to the south are a far cry from the deceptive calm of the mists around you.  Two charred and beaten towers survey the countryside and hold silent vigil over the town, flanking the road to the east and west.
title: [The Rift]
12198.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thousands upon thousands of black wings cover the walls, moving restlessly in an almost deafening whisper of feathers.  Eyes wink out from beneath the ebon pinions, glaring malevolently at you before being covered once again.
title: [The Rift]
12199.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A circular marble pillar sits in the middle of a room with thick grey tapestries for walls.  Above this pillar floats a large skull that appears to be serpentine or lizardlike in nature, slowly rotating in a sphere of blue energy.  The skull rotates, morphing into an elven one, then gently spinning again and changing into a human one, then a krolvin skull, then a giant one, and finally back to the serpent one.
title: [The Rift]
12200.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge three-masted ship floats in midair here just above the ground, sails rippling gently in the slight breeze.  Deck hands from on board make noise as they move about, adjusting cargo and preparing for voyage.  From the crow's nest high above, you can see the ship's falconer directing large hunting hawks through aerial warm-up exercises.
title: [The Rift]
12201.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fog parts revealing a pitch black area.  Blackness wraps around you like a velvety greatcloak as you step tenatively into the dark.  A slithering hiss surrounds you, circling you several times before retreating into the heavy silence and darkness.
title: [The Rift]
12202.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A forest of large trees stretches in all directions.  Their bark is an ashen grey, and their leaves almost glow crimson in the dim light.  Tied to each tree is a man, arms over his head and bound tightly against the rough bark.  Each man is alive, if only barely, emaciated and weak from lack of food or water.  Every head is bowed, awaiting the sacrifice each knows he must make.
title: [The Rift]
12203.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A huge cliff looms before you, stretching far into the sky above.  About halfway up the face an immense red-skinned man rides the air currents, flapping his leathery wings to hold his position.  On the wall next to him are crude columns made of bodies impaled to the wall, each column topped off with a different type of weapon resting on rough hooks.
title: [The Rift]
12204.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long line of robed monks walks solemnly, fading off into the distance.  They seem to be traveling toward the largest mountain of a set which runs across the distant horizon.  Two bursts of flame shoot up from an opening in the mountain occasionally, illuminating a skull-shaped castle and a line of supplicants several miles long moving towards it.
title: [The Rift]
12205.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Gargoyles hover above a huge, dark pit in the ground a small distance off.  They occasionally swoop into it, then shoot out on a burst of air, screaming with excitement.  All manner of bugs and small creatures swarm around the lip of the hole, the thick ring oozing slowly outward from its point of origin.
title: [The Rift]
12212.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense tapestry hangs here in midair.  Thin magical threads create the shimmering cloth, almost seeming to move and adjust themselves as they hang.  Several long, shadowy outlines hover near the tapestry, attending to the minor knots and slips.  At this position you are too close to see the entire work of art, but it does seem somehow familiar.
title: [The Rift]
12213.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The road beneath your feet is made of grey stone, polished smooth and slick save several deep gouges in each cobble.  Looking more closely, the scratches form words...names of those beloved to you.  With a start, you realize the cobbles are not paving stones after all, but headstones, laid flat to create a path of the dead.
title: [The Rift]
12214.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick mist covers the ground in this small cemetery.  Moss-covered headstones and graves placed in a chaotic order stretch as far as the eye can see.  Several tombs rest on a small hill in the center of the quiet graves, on which three shapeless collections of ooze gather.  As you watch them, they morph into various shapes and sizes, speaking amongst themselves in some deep, flowing tongue.
title: [The Rift]
12216.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An immense statue stands before you towering hundreds of feet high, giving you an excellent view of its ankle.  The statue has a large, muscular frame, and is resting his hands on the pommel of a two-handed sword.  As you look up the statue's length, you realize it has one fatal flaw - it's headless.
title: [The Rift]
12218.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A portrait rests against an immense boulder here.  The boulder seems to have a vaguely familiar shape, but exactly what is too difficult to place.  Leaning against the base of the boulder is a modwir-framed picture, depicting an incredibly strong man wrestling with a heavy burden.  The rock he holds appears to grow heavier, and he looks tired and pained by the weight of it.  At the base of the painting before you are two footprints imbedded deeply into the ground.
title: [The Rift]
12221.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fragments of fine glass mirrors line the walls, floor and ceiling here.  Each reflects back your face and form, but no two images are the same.  To your left you lie dead, body broken and mangled.  To your right you hang from a gallows, struggling for your last breath before the noose steals it from you.  No mirror grants reprieve from the horrific reflections, and it seems you cannot look in any direction without seeing yourself frighteningly deceased.
title: [The Rift]
12222.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A shoreline stretches before you, the sea dark and thick with salt.  Just a small way up the beach, an unusual sight catches your eye.  A small child walks the beach, holding hands with a large winged humanoid.  One of its reddish wings is wrapped protectively around the child, and her small hand is tightly clutching one of his large fingers. She appears to be talking, although what she is saying is too difficult to understand to any except her unusual companion.
title: [The Rift]
12223.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A beached ship lies in the middle of the field here, no clues or explanation as to how it arrived.  The once shiny maoral wood has dulled now with age, and the ship's ribs and masts have split and fallen.  The only passengers of the vessel are the rats, which number in the thousands.  It's almost as if the boat itself writhes with their movements.  High above, on the one remaining mast, flies a flag bearing a rat skull and crossbones.
title: [The Rift]
12224.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A marble wall stretches for some distance to either side of you.  In the center of the wall hangs a golden scale, with a small shelf on either side of it.  On each of the shelves lies a shiny razor and a white towel.  The bowls of the scales are spotless, although they have a slight coppery odor.
title: [The Rift]
12225.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide stretch of forest opens before you, the huge border of trees giving the impression of stoic guards protecting their land and secrets.  Packs of ghostly dogs run toward you at the will of a huge, antlered man commanding them at the forest border.  His bony finger points to you, and the dark gleam in his eye tells you he will not allow passage further into the woods.
title: [The Rift]
12226.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The darkness seems to wrap about you, seeking to hold you and bind you to it.  But the darkness is cold, burning and scalding you with its icy touch.  Too alien to be the comfortable darkness of the night, too hungry to be the peace of a room with curtains drawn, it leeches and draws the strength from you, threatening to leave you a dried husk.
title: [The Rift]
12227.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Even for a giant, the body laying on the ground before you is huge.  It lies face down, a pool of blood widening slowly around it.  The giant's outstretched arms clutch a battle axe in one hand and a thin veil iron circlet in the other, as if to keep hold of them even in death.  Fortunately, the pack of wild dogs ripping at the body doesn't seem to care about them, only about their dinner.
title: [The Rift]
20876.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A stout wooden wall impedes your progress forward.  In the center of the wall, on a large yellowed parchment, is a poster.  The poster is a side view of a man laying in a coffin or box of some kind.  Small arrows point to parts of the picture, and in an unknown language describe some of the things in it.  A second, older poster next to the first has the picture of an old, one-eyed dark elf with the number "12000" below it.
title: [The Rift]
20877.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A large snow-filled valley with rough sloping sides opens up before you.  On the ridge tops from one end to the other stand two main groups of creatures.  The north ridge holds huge clans of ice trolls standing ready with large slabs of ice, while on the south ridge groups of frost giants mutter at each other, holding equally large slabs.  In the center of the valley a lone storm giant stands, arms up to signal the racers.
title: [The Rift]
20878.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A giant hangs on an elaborate set of poles and straps here.  Two thick poles set crossing each other are framed by two vertical and two horizontal ones.  Violet eyes shrouded in shadow float near the giant's head, watching the expressions that pass there with great interest.  A pair of winged snakes hover near the giant, flying idly about and occasionally striking him.
title: [The Rift]
20879.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Climbing a small hill, you now look over a long valley filled with warriors.  A huge giantman in plate-mail stands at the front of the vanguard, holding a battle axe in each hand.  His skin is rotted and mildewed, and the hollow eye sockets drop bits of goo and small bugs.  The entire host of undead soldiers shifts anxiously behind him, as if waiting for a command from their chieftain.
title: [The Rift]
20880.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The granite wall before you is covered in a huge mural of gouges and scratches.  The pattern spreads from the bottom of the wall upwards, branching much like a tree into various parts.  Studying the damage a bit more, you realize it was all very carefully planned, although why isn't immediately apparent.
title: [The Rift]
20881.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A long field stretches before you, covered by dark clouds.  The field is lined with rows and rows of long metal poles, each of which is situated near a stone door.  While you look over the field, lightning flashes down from the clouds and strikes one of the poles.  As the pole absorbs the burst of energy, the door nearest to it slowly swings open, revealing a black stone passage behind.  The door stays open a few seconds, then slowly swings closed again.
title: [The Rift]
20882.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Mountains surround you, stretching high into the bright green sky.  Before you, towering at least thirty feet into the air, is a giant snake.  It has been impaled on a pike, blood trickling down the pole and seeping into the grain of the wood.  The tip of its tail still twitches, as if its death were a recent happening.

title: [The Rift]
12095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The ground beneath you is white, strangely grainy and light.  Tunnels lead off to the northeast and southwest, winding erratically through the odd earth.  Walls made of a hard, transparent material close about you, distorting the images beyond them.  Looking carefully, it almost seems that a small human sits just beyond the glass, staring at you with great interest.

description: Black sand dunes stretch out to infinity.  No plants grow from the ebon ground, and you can hear no small animals or insects going about their business nearby.  In the distance, a triangular shape moves along the ground, breaking the surface of the sand and winding its way towards you before disappearing beneath the surface once again.

description: Rain pours from the ground.  It falls upwards, drenching the clouds with moisture and forming small puddles in the sky.  The occasional bolt of lightning strikes upwards, and thunder rolls through the air, bouncing off distant mountains to echo back with a faint roar.

Foods with mouthwatering aromas line the walls, served by smiling butlers in finely tailored clothing.  At the head of the table sit the bride and groom, holding a golden cup to each other's lips.  By the advanced stages of decay, you estimate that the happy couple has been dead for several hundred years.

description: A knight in black armor rides through a crowd, his black steed prancing with ringing steps.  In his hand he holds a staff, topped with the head of a vanquished foe.  Five footsoldiers march beside him, holding similarly adorned staves.  Despite the hard and cruel expression on the knight's face, the crowd seems to adore him, cheering and throwing dead roses in his path.

His grey hair is held back by a golden crown, and his beard flows down his broad chest.  Upon the side of the stone is carved a set of characters. description: The chapel walls are lined with statues, one for each of the Lords of Liabo and Lornon.  The statues seem to have been carved from wax, detailed to the long eyelashes of Ivas and the polished claws of Andelas.  It is impossible to see the detail of the Gods of Light, for the wax has melted, turning them into misshapen and twisted replicas of what they once were.

description: Spectres crowd around you.  Their ghostly hands reach out to touch you, seeking the warmth and vitality only the living have.  But as each grasping figure makes contact it draws back, wailing in pain as if burned.  Still the others seek to feel you, expressions of hunger on their haunted faces.

description: The dining hall is full of shadows, lit only dimly by guttering candles.  Around the table sit nine skeletons, each holding a golden cup.  The undead seem to be chatting, drinking from their chalices only to have the liquid flow out and over their ribcages.  With a wave of disgust, you realize that the skeletons are drinking blood.

title: [The Rift]
12138.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Lava boils over the ground, leaving you only narrow trails to walk between the streams of molten stone.  Sticking out from the liquid rock are grasping hands, seeking assistance although surely the people they are attached to are dead.  Suddenly, a body erupts from the magma. description: Tiny rivulets of water trickle slowly down a multitude of stalactites and drip noisily onto the stalagmites rising from the frozen ground.  There are jagged shards of ice everywhere that crunch loudly beneath your feet as you explore this icy chamber.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3476.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: There is scarcely enough room to move about in this frightfully cold recess.  Yet, it is evident that something ventures into this tiny area.  Your breath forms a frosty mist as you shudder violently at the thought of being trapped in this confining space.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3477.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: On first glance, this chamber looks like the others -- until you notice a slick, icy pile of rocks against the far wall, and the frozen corpse slumped beside them.  Upon closer inspection, you discover that the ice-glazed body is frozen to the rocks themselves.  Nothing short of a thorough thaw will free the pitiful soul for a proper burial.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3478.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The only exit from this small chamber is the gap through which you entered.  Overhead, the fissure ends with a hole from which slowly trickles a constant dripping of water.  The ground is slick with layered ice that extends to all the walls.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3479.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Something very heavy has trampled through the area, packing snow into the icy ground and making it very slippery.  If it weren't for the feeling of imminent danger, you might actually enjoy spending more time exploring -- as it is, you dare not linger too long.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3480.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This chamber seems somewhat drier but it is darker and just as bone-chilling cold as the others you have seen.  The frigid conditions are sapping your energy, making merely staying awake a supreme effort.
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3481.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The light is so dim that you fail to see the huge mound of ice until you are upon it!  Peering closely, you discover that the mass is an ice-glazed titan who is sitting -- staring eyes opened wide and quite dead!
title: [Deep Freeze, Cave of Ice]
3482.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Torches illuminate a row of suits of full plate armor that stand like sentinels along the landing.  To the west, a series of narrow mullioned bay windows that enclose a polished oak bench offer an expansive view of the remote trail that connects Wehnimer's Landing and Icemule Trace.  A few sheets of parchment and a scattering of mithril figures, arrayed for battle atop a painted map, rest upon a narrow table at one end of the landing.  A bookcase stands nearby, filled with leather-bound volumes and additional maps.

description: Large enough to swallow a modest inn whole, the great hall is clearly the heart of the castle.  Braziers and a massive fieldstone hearth provide just enough light to reveal exposed ironwood beams high above the bearskin rugs and leather chairs scattered throughout the chamber.  Tapestries depicting scenes of battles and hunts add color to stone walls.  Pine boughs arranged on a T-shaped table that could seat a small army combine their fragrance with the pungent aromas of ale and roasted meats.  A grey granite throne inlaid with ironwood rises amidst a menagerie of trophy heads.
23273.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Highguard Keep, Great Hall]

description: Crenellated granite walls provide protection for archers, but offer little defense against the ever-present northern winds at this altitude.  From this vantage point, the lights of surrounding lodges and townships become tiny constellations mirroring the ones above you.  Though now home only to a pair of snowy owls that have built a nest in the lee of one wall, a discarded ballista bolt suggests the roof recently held weapons of war.  A tall flagpole stands firmly in the ironwood planking.
23274.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Highguard Keep, Rooftop]

description: High ceilings and smooth, plaster-coated stone walls give this large room a surprisingly airy feel.  A smaller version of the fieldstone fireplace in the hall below keeps the bedchamber comfortable, as a north-facing window is shuttered tightly against the evening's chill.  Although a rough-hewn oak bed lavishly draped with furs dominates the room, a free-standing grindstone and a well-stocked weapons rack draw attention near the window.  Two small tables guard the bed, while an enormous mithril vault is built into the opposing wall.
23275.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace
title: [Highguard Keep, Bedchamber]

assignment.title: [Highguard Keep, Bedchamber]
assignment.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

description: Constant activity in this spacious bailey keeps the swirling snow from blanketing the cobbled courtyard.  Wooden stables and storerooms cling to the perimeter walls, but the grey granite exterior of the compound's towering inner keep is bare except for an incised cornerstone.  Crenellated battlements top the keep, overhanging the steep structure like a beetled brow, and obscuring the stars behind them.  Tucked into a protected corner near the northern stables is a small fountain.  To the south, a snow-dusted marble statue presides over a row of archery butts.

description: This storage space is so packed with food that builders have added a wooden loft to hold the excess.  Cheese wheels, wine casks, salted meats, and barrels of vegetables would surely be enough to withstand a months-long siege, yet the freshness of the food suggests it's just the weekly supply.  Round wooden covers conceal a pair of brick-lined chambers dug into the frosty soil where perishables can be kept cold.
23277.location: Highguard Keep, outside the glacier-locked town of Icemule Trace

description: A precarious ledge juts out from the wall and a few broken stones of the well shaft's lining, icy to the touch, serve as a handhold.  The pale circle of the well's mouth above outlines a rusted winch.  A fraying rope dangles past you into the shadows below.
title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
3459.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The well's bucket is firmly lodged in a mass of frozen tree limbs and dried brush.  The rope holding the bucket, grey with frost, dangles slackly above, rising upward like a wisp of smoke.  There doesn't seem to be any way to get farther down.
title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
3460.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A ladder of woven palm fronds hangs over the wide ledge and is the only way to gain entry to the pit.  It looks quite frayed and in terrible condition, with most of the fronds torn or tattered.  The giant red splatter stains on the floor below are not reassuring in the least.
title: [Thurfel's Cellar]
3781.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tightly packed brush and branches form a low ceiling.  A few icicles point downward, but the air is warmer than above.  Even allowing for the absence of wind, it shouldn't be this warm...not that anyone's likely to complain.
title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
9093.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shattered paving stones mark where the well once ended.  A dark crack runs the length of the floor and beyond are a set of stairs curving down into the darkness.  Grating encircles you, where water must have once entered.  The floor is bone-dry now.
title: [Icemule Trace, Well]
9094.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Wide stairs of limestone curve down into the depths around a central shaft. The stairs go no further upward, but a dark opening leads somewhere.  A warm mist gathers around you like a cloud on a mountain top.
title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
9095.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone of the stairs and walls is pitted and flakes off easily.  Even so, the stairs are sturdy and seem to have stood for ages.  Glowing moss grows in occasional patches, illuminating the steps with a dull shine.
title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
9096.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stairs corkscrew up and down into the gloom.  The air is cold near the rock walls, but warm currents force their way up the shaft out of the darkness.
title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
9097.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stone steps grow warmer as they descend.  The passing of the numbing cold is a welcome change as insensitive feet can easily misstep, but with the new warmth comes another change less welcome.  The stairs are now covered with a thin layer of slime.
title: [Great Cavern, Limestone Stairs]
9098.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A wide tunnel extends straight upwards.  Below, the tunnel slopes downward and off to one side a bit.  The ceiling of the flue is covered in thick glowing moss and a drop or two of water falls from above.  The air is still cool here, but well above freezing.
title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
9099.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The natural vent is wider than it is tall as it slopes lazily upwards.  Rough steps are carved periodically in the wall that serves as a floor, although they aren't strictly necessary.
title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
9100.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Moss grows so thickly around you that it is impossible to make out the stone behind it.  A constant flow of warm, moist air feeds the glowing moss.  It hangs down in clumps here and there, almost to the floor where another sort grows in rough clumps.
title: [Great Cavern, Flue]
9101.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A vast forest of rock formations stretches off in all directions.  The ceiling is low here, and a squat stalagmite hill leads up to the opening of a natural flue.  It would be pretty easy to scramble up it.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9102.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A particularly large stalagmite squats here among the others.  The sides are awash with natural flowing stone deposits. Its tip merges with a stalactite above, resembling a giant apple core.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9103.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The massive stalagmites stretch up toward the ceiling.  In most places you cannot make out their tips, as a cloud-like fog rolls about the cavern's ceiling.  Another layer of fog obscures your feet, hovering a yard off the floor.  Below and above the air is relatively clear.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, southeast, southwest
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9104.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: At the edge of the caverns thin sheets of stone cling between the rock formations and the walls.  Fog puddles between the stone dividers, making misty alcoves for the tired adventurer.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9105.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A clearing opens unexpectedly among the columns of stone.  The strange double-layer of fog still obscures floor and ceiling, but you begin to get a sense of how truly large this cavern is.  In the open space, the charred remnants of a fire mar the stone floor beneath the mist.  It's impossible to say whether this was some battle, a camp, or perhaps a religious rite.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9106.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The fog that rolls about the cavern in twin layers has grown so thick here that it is a single massive bank of dark grey.  Dim shapes of stone mark the edges of your vision like sentries.  Every now and then the fog lifts a bit, giving you a glimpse of what lies beyond.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9107.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The vaulted ceiling disappears above you.  Through the mist that curls about the stalactites, you almost imagine you can see a glimmer of light creeping its way down from the surface above.  Fact or fancy, the skeleton of a snake entwines itself nearby, as if basking in the sun.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9108.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An ancient landslide blocks the way to the north.  The scrabble of stones rests securely now under a glaze of mineral deposits.  A lone mushroom peeks up through a crack in the stone.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9109.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The stalagmites and stalactites stand farther apart as the cavern opens to the south.  The cavern slopes downward and is quickly covered by a layer of mud and plant debris.  The thin layers of mist behind you are replaced by a thick yellow fog that shrouds the bog below you.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, west, northwest, down
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9110.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cavern continues to the west, but a dark fissure blocks any further progress.  Fumes pour forth in waves, and it takes a moment to recover from their impact.  Fortified with a deep breath and steeled to the reek, the stench is just bearable.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9111.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the east the floor of the cavern rises to meet the ceiling.  A dark vent may lead into another chamber beyond, but there is too much rubble to get near.  A small spring bubbles between the rocks and trickles off to the southwest.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9112.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Shattered stone covers the ground, crunching underfoot and seeking to lame the unwary with its sharp edges.  Several columns lie in cracked sections where they seem to have been cast down to either side by some great force.  Whatever the force was, it came from the bog to the south.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9113.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: There must be a stone floor beneath the mist here, but it is covered by thick, oozing mud.  You might step down into it to find out how deep it goes, but a little voice tells you that you are better off keeping to the firmer spots.  Odd sounds reverberate through the dark mist, continuing too long to be echos.
paths: Obvious exits: east, south, west, up
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9114.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The mud moves underneath the platform of vines on which you stand.  It may be some great slimy creature moving about, or it may be a river flowing below you.  In any event, a nearby stalagmite serves as a welcome crutch as the vines slip about unsteadily.
paths: Obvious exits: north, east, south, west
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9115.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The sheer west wall of the cavern looms darkly in the gray haze.  A great plant has grown against it, perhaps finding some solid purchase among the cracked stone.  The plant is like nothing you've ever seen, half mold and half palm.
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9116.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Fog drifts lazily across what could easily be a desolate swamp above ground, were it not for the spikes of stone rising out of the marsh.  Only a thick layer of decaying vines makes the bog passable.  Giant fireflies flit madly about just out of reach.
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9117.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The cavern narrows suddenly, its walls pressing inwards and the ceiling descending.  Fog swirls in from all sides and pours into the huge opening creating a curtain of mist.  Beneath your feet, the muck is definitely flowing slowly into the arch.
paths: Obvious exits: north, northeast, south, northwest
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9118.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Vines hang down from above in a shaggy curtain.  They are thick and tangled, and some bear an uncomfortable resemblance to hangmen's nooses.  Beneath your feet, thicker vines form a shifting platform across the mire.
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9119.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The west wall of the cavern rises suddenly out of the mist.  A thin layer of fog pours down like a waterfall, but there's no telling quite where the fog is coming from.  The stone is cool to the touch and covered with glowing moss.  To the south, the stone floor of the cavern is swallowed by a mushy bog.
title: [Great Cavern, Stalagmite Forest]
9120.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A swarm of giant fireflies crawls over the surface of the east wall of the cavern.  Even through the thick fog, their combined luminescence is painful to eyes grown accustomed to making do with fainter shadows and shades of gray.
title: [Great Cavern, Bog]
9121.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Before you stretches a vast underground lake.  The ceiling and the far shore are lost in darkness and mist, but there is enough water here to create small waves lapping at your feet.  As elsewhere in the great cavern, stalagmites rise out of the murky water.  Beyond them huddles the dark form of an island.
title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
9122.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: To the east the waters of the bog flow slowly into the dark lake.  A rock outcropping gives you firm footing to one side and a clearer view of the island offshore.  Even from this vantage point, the rocky humps can only be dimly seen through the fog on the water.
title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
9123.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Masses of lichen cover the wall of the cavern and drape out into the stagnant water.  They cling among the stalagmites dotting the lake forming a natural bridge across its surface.  How sturdy it is is anybody's guess.
title: [Subterranean Lake, Shore]
9124.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Two slabs of stone leave a few feet to squeeze between, and that at an angle that is sure to cause permanent injury to spine and hips if you don't keep moving.  Bursts of air from below carry a searing heat and a stench that would make Onar blanch.
title: [Dark Fissure]
9125.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This chamber is almost perfectly round except where it is marred by cracks and openings in floor and ceiling.  A powerful stench fills the nostrils.  Whatever foul wizard's breath gathers here, it must be light, for it seems to pool in the ceiling and spark into flame periodically.  The unnatural flashes of lighting illuminate the chamber fitfully.
title: [Gas Pocket]
9126.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Thick sheets of lichen lie across the surface of the water, bobbing and swaying with the slightest bit of movement.  The sheets also stretch vertically between the stalagmites that anchor them, obscuring any view of the lake beyond.
title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
9127.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Incredible as it seems, the lichen is almost impervious to tearing.  Where a bit has been ripped away, you can make out another layer beneath.  For all you can tell, it may extend down to the bottom of the lake.  The bridge stretches away to the north and twists slightly as it heads south.
title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
9128.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The lichen grows happily here, its surface slick with moss and mold.  The natural fabric is so thick and abundant that its excess folds almost block your way.  Still, with a good deal of pushing and scrambling, it's possible to make some progress.
title: [Cavern, Lichen Bridge]
9129.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall stalagmites arch above your head, curving to almost meet above you.  They form a pair of rows, bound together with limestone deposits and moss.  You don't recall ever seeing stalagmites bent that way before.  To the north, a dark green opening leads to a lichen-lined tunnel.
title: [Mossy Hollow]
9130.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Murky water stretches into the haze in all directions.  To the south the island curves away in a long rocky spit.  To the north a lower hill rests beyond a row of natural stepping stones.  Moss covers the island from one end to the other.  The top of the hill is split open revealing a mossy cave below.
title: [Subterranean Island, Large Hill]
9131.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The hillside slopes downward to a row of stepping stones to the north.  Offshore to the west a stone reef stretches away at a right angle.  Below it and to the south a dark shelf lies just below the surface of the lake.
title: [Subterranean Island, Large Hill]
9132.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: An almost straight row of stepping stones rises out of the lake between the two hills of the island.  Whether they were placed here or are natural is difficult to say.  Moss covers the stones, but they are wide enough that there is little danger of falling into the muddy depths.
title: [Subterranean Island, Stones]
9133.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: This small hill rises forlornly just above the water's edge.  Jagged rocks surround a tiny inaccessible cove on the north shore.  There is something unsettling about the place.
title: [Subterranean Island, Hillock]
9134.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The south end of the main hill drops away slowly to the water's surface.  Moss and lichen line the stones, making a springy carpet beneath the feet.  Overhead, great fireflies wheel and dart in the cool updrafts over the lake.
title: [Subterranean Island, Rocky Spit]
9135.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: As the island comes to an end, the spit disappears into a line of stones.  They offer footing out into the lake a ways, a natural pier with no boats to dock.  Every now and then a small wave washes over them, making you think twice about heading too far out.  Who knows what manner of great reptilian beast might frequent this cavern?
title: [Subterranean Island, Rocky Spit]
9136.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Small flat stones jut from the water, closely spaced such that even a halfling could scamper from rock to rock with no difficulty.  The water sloshes gently over the path now and again, briefly covering the stones then sliding effortlessly off the smooth surfaces.
title: [Raised Stone Path]
9137.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The water swells and ebbs in an easy, soft rhythm, occasionally slopping over the sides of the smooth stone path that pokes up from the clear, dark surface of the underground lake.  From time to time, a small splash breaks the water, ripples gliding away from the obvious point of disturbance.
title: [Raised Stone Path]
9138.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A simple path of smooth, flat stones leads off into the water to the southwest, ending here on a clean, white sandy beach.  Small footprints lead in all directions, their paths crossing and recrossing dozens of times before leading off to the north.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9139.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A very large statue of a very squat halfling has been constructed on the tip of the island.  It stands upon a pedestal of polished pink coral, and is made completely from eroded chunks of seaglass.  In spite of the odd material used to create the artwork, the piece is quite detailed.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9140.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Tall orange grass shaped in tight spirals covers the fine sand of this beach.  The spring-like plants bounce upward with every passing breeze, the motion scattering the many tiny golden butterflies that are flittering about the stalks.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9141.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A tiny toy boat bobs placidly near the dock, far too small to carry any passengers.  It is not attached with any rope, yet for some odd reason, it does not float off with the tide.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9142.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A slate-tiled path leads to a small keep that has been constructed entirely of garishly colored stones.  There seems to be no rhyme or reason to this structure, only madness.  The only visible entrance to this small castle is through a pink coral portcullis.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9143.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The looming wall of a strange-looking keep has been decorated with an odd assortment of seashells and hollowed coconuts.  Perhaps it's just an illusion, but the pattern of shells suggests the shape of a tart.  A splintery wooden ladder has been dragged along the sand and discarded.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9144.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A massive clump of hand-crafted stone palm trees surrounds an artificial pond.  The water-like substance making up the pool is a translucent blue material and is utterly lifelike, looking as if it were frozen in time.  Two grooves are cut deep into the sand and lead off to the southwest.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9145.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A rickety pier has been built along the beachside and it leads off to provide a short walkway over the sea.  The wood is warped from the constant moisture in the air, and the entire structure looks unsafe at best.  A battered sign has been posted.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9146.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.

The pier comes to a sudden and abrupt end with no guard rail or warning.  The broken and cracked bits of plank point to either storm damage or just plain rot.  A watery vortex churns dangerously in the waters just below the pier, its center crackling with energy.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9147.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: Odd tremors at your feet reveal the fearsome power of the lake.  Large waves crash onto the beach with a thunderous roar, each new wave exploding in a spray of white surf as it pounds into the trembling sand.  The water lingers for but a moment before the water recalls its violent probe.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9148.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The pounding surf beats upon the shore with monotonous intensity, seeking nothing more than to make its presence felt.  The constant slap of the waves has dragged off most of the sand within the area, and the slow erosion has revealed the tip of a buried object made of obsidian.  It is impossible to discern what exactly is protruding from the sand.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9149.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: A shallow tidepool filled with an assortment of bizarre critters sits amidst a congregation of smooth round stones.  The crystal-clear water ripples softly, the tiny waves not seeming to bother the sea life within.  Along the bottom of the pond, a sea star slowly glides along, each of its five arms wildly different.
title: [Thurfel's Island]
9150.ownership_source: Native map metadata; unassigned display groups are not new areas

description: The rear of the keep is constructed of thick palm fronds and hardened mud. description: Lava seethes from cracks in the tortured earth near the narrow ribbon of stable ground.
